TO: I With verbs of motion: by acc., I was taken to the edifice of the princess: nIto'haM kanyakAniketanam, D. vii. (G. § 162-3).II Expressing indirect object: by dat., shew- ing to the queen: darSayan patnyE, R. (G. § 180.). III With inf.: by inf., I have come to impart the knowledge: vidyAM dAtumupAgato'sBi, Ki. v. 23. (G. § 279-83).IV With special verb: q. v. V. In comparison to: by gen., who are other archers to me: ke mama Danvino'nye, Ku. iii. 10. (G. § 211, 209),VI Of direction: to the north-west of Kailāsa: kElAsAt paScimodIcyAm, Mat.: to the north of Nishadha: nizaDasyottareRa, Mah. (G. § 207, 196).VII=towards: q. v. VIII=up to: q. v.: A with abl. or in comp., to the coast of the four oceans: A pAreByaScaturRA- mamBoDInAm, Mu. iii. 24.IX Expressing number: expr. by comp., to the number of five hundred: paYcaSatasaMKyaka (f. kA).X In other senses; hand to hand: hastAhasti; to one's face: sammuKe; “to his ruin”: svanASAya; “she to his image was made”: sA tadanurUpA kftA; “I have a king here to my flatterer”: ayaM rAjA mama stAvakaBUmO vartate.

TO , prep. Many of the meanings of ‘to’ are expressed by prepositions or affixes, or by the infin. mood, or are in- herent in the inflections of the Sanskrit noun; thus, (Mo- tion to or toward any place) expressed by the acc. case alone, or with prati &c. added; as, ‘he went to the city,’ nagaraM or nagaraM prati jagAma, or by the gen. c., with antikaM &c.; as, ‘he sent me to you,’ mAM tavAntikaM or tava sakASam aprEbIt. — (Motion to any state) by the acc. c.; as, ‘he attains to fame,’ KyAtiM yAti. — (Adaptation) by the dat. c. or crude form; as, ‘that husband was not to her taste,’ sa patis tasyAH santozAya nABavat; ‘suited to royalty,’ rAjayogyaH -gyA -gyaM, rAjArhaH &c.; ‘that is pleasing to me,’ tan mahyaM rocate. — (Address, declaration, compellation) by the acc. c. or dat. c.; as, ‘he addressed a speech to the king,’ rAjAnaM vacanam abravIt; ‘speak to me,’ mAM brUhi; ‘I will declare this to my pupils,’ SizyeByaH pravakzyAmi tat; ‘he made it known to the king,’ tad rAjYe vijYApayati. — (Giving) by the dat., gen., or loc. c.; ‘he gives sweetmeats to his son,’ putrAya or putrasya modakAn dadAti. — (Up to, as far as, denoting extent, degree, &c.) A prefixed to the abl. or acc. c., paryyanta or anta in comp.; as, ‘to the ocean,’ AsamudrAt or samudraparyyantaM; ‘to the throat,’ AkaRWAt; ‘to the knee,’ AjAnu; ‘the numbers from one up to ten thousand,’ ekAdyayutAntasaMKyAH. — (Posses- sion, appertainment) by the gen. c.; as, ‘money belongs to me,’ mama DanaM Bavati. — (Purpose, intention, object) by the dat. c. or infin. mood, or by arTaM &c. affixed; as, ‘the [Page806-a+ 51] sat down to consult,’ mantraRAya or mantrayituM or mantraRArTam upavizwAH; ‘the barber came to shave his master,’ BarttfkzOrakaraRAya nApita AgacCat; ‘he came to make peace,’ sanDiM karttum AgacCat; ‘give me something to eat,’ AhArArTaM kiYcin mama dehi. — (As a sign of the infinitive) expressed by the infinitive, or by yaTA &c.; as, ‘unable to move,’ calitum asamarTaH; ‘I desire to hear,’ Srotum icCAmi; ‘I did not expect to see you again,’ na ma AsId ASaMsA yaTA punarapi tvAM prekzipye. There may be other ways of expressing ‘to’ in Sanskrit, as in the following examples: ‘the peacock dances to the songs of the bees,’ SiKI nftyati maDukaragItEH; ‘he performed penance to the deity,’ devam uddiSya tapas tepe; ‘the town was speedily reduced to ashes,’ nagarI sahasA BasmasAd akriyata; ‘compared to that,’ tadapekzya or tadapekzayA; ‘to the east of the village,’ prAg grAmAt; ‘he goes to and f
TO-DAY , s. or adv. adya; ‘of to-day,’ adyatanaH -nI -naM.
TO-MORROW , s. or adv. Svas, paredyas, paradinaM, see MORROW; ‘day after,’ paraSvas; ‘belonging to to-morrow,’ SvastanaH -nI -naM, SvastyaH &c.,
TO-NIGHT: adya rAtrO, niSi, naktaM or rajanyAm
TO-NIGHT , adv. adya rAtrO, adya niSi, adya naktaM.
Toad, s. maMqUkaH. [Toad]y, s. miTyASaMsakaH.
TOAD: maRqUkaH: v. Frog.
TOAD , s. sTUlamaRqUkaH, sTUlaBekaH, varzABUH m.
TOADSTOOL: a plant: CatraviSezaH.
TOADSTOOL , s. gomayaCatraM, viqjaM, viqjaCatraM. See FUNGUS.
TOAST: I Subs.: BfzwaM rowiKaRqam.II Verb.: Bfjjati (Brasj, c. 6.): v. To fry. Ph.: to drink a t.: *jalapAnaM karoti.
To TOAST , v. a. upAgni DftvA SuzkIkf, agniSuzkaM -zkAM kf, agninA tap (c. 10. tApayati -yituM), Bfj, Brajj. See To FRY, v. a.
TOAST , s. dagDApUpaH, dagDapizwakaH, agniSuzkApUpaH, BfzwApUpaH.
TOASTED , p. p. BfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, BarjitaH -tA -taM, agniSuzkaH -zkA -zkaM.
Tobacco, s. tamAKuH.
TOBACCO: tAmrakUwaH or -kuwwaH, -kaH.
TOBACCO , s. tAmrakuwwaH -wwakaH, tAmrakUwaH, tAmrapatrikA.
TOBACCONIST: tAmrakuwwavikrayin (f. nI) and sim. comp. s.
TOBACCONIST , s. tAmrakuwwavikrayI m. (n), tAmrakuwwakavyApArI m.
Tocsin, s. BayaDvaniH; BayasUcikA GaMwA.
TOCSIN , s. AsannaBayasUcakaGaRwA, BayajYApakaGaRwA.
TODAY: cAwuSIla (f. lA): v. Sycophant.
TODAY: adya, of t.: adyatanaH (nI, naM), talliKyatA- madyatano divasaH. P.: v. Also now.
TODAY: (1) tAqiH(qI);(2) tAlI.
To TODDLE , v. n. bAlakavat sKaladgatyA kram or car.
Toddy, s. tAlI.
TODDY , s. (Of the palm) tAlI, tAlakI, tAqI -qiH f. — (Of the cocoa-nut) nArikelAsavaH, nArikerAsavaH.

TOE: (1) aNguliH, -lI (when the sense is clear), R. vi. 15.;(2) pAdANguliH, -lI and sim. comp. s. The great t.: pAdANguzWaH or sim. aNguzWaH, (when the sense is clear). Ph.: from top to t.: A keSAgrAdA naKAntAt, At.
TOE , s. pAdANgulI -liH f., pAdANguriH f., padANgulI -liH f., pAdaSAKA, aNguriH f.; ‘the great toe,’ pAdANguzWaH; ‘the little toe,’ pAdasya kanizWANgulI; ‘toe-nail,’ pAdanaKaH, caraRanaKaH.

TOGETHER: I In gen.:(1) ekatra, these families t. number fourteen: etAnyekatra caturdaSakulAni, K.; all excellences do not live t.: na vasantyekatra sarveguRAH, [Page715] Vi. i. 33.;(2) saha, gen. in comp. (= co-), coming out t.: sahEva niryatI, Ki. xiv. 56.; living t.: sahavasatiH, Sa. ii. 3.;(3) samam (rare), flew t.: samaM samutpetuH, Ki. xiv. 45.II With verbs.: sam in comp., mix t.: saMmiSrayati; live t.: saMvasati, etc.III T. with: saha (rarely sAkam, samam or sArDam with ins.): v. With.

TOGETHER , adv. (In company) saha in comp., samaM, sahitaM, eka in comp., ekatra; ‘going together,’ sahagAmI -minI &c.; ‘danc- ing together,’ sahanarttanaM; ‘drinking together,’ sahapAnaM; ‘eat- ing together,’ sahaBojanaM, ekaBojanaM, ekatra BojanaM; ‘fighting together,’ sahayuDvA m. (n); ‘all together, in a body,’ saNGa- Sas, ekasaNGe -NGatas, sAkalyena. — (Into union or junction) sam prefixed; as, ‘to bind together,’ sambanD; ‘to meet together,’ saNgam, sammil; ‘having the feet together,’ sampadaM; ‘two letters placed together,’ sannihitavarRO m. du. — (In the same place) ekatra, ekasTAne, ekadeSe. — (At the same time) ekakAle, samakAle, yugapat, saha in comp.; ‘born at the same time,’ ekakAlajaH -jA -jaM, samakAlajaH &c., sahajaH &c. — (With one another) parasparaM, anyonyaM; ‘quarelling together,’ parasparakalahaH, anyonyakalahaH. — (Together with) saha, samaM, sArdDaM, sahitaM, sAkaM, all with instr. c.; ‘together with him,’ tena saha.
Toil, v. i. yat 1 A, Sram 4 P, Ayas 4 P. s. SramaH, AyAsaH.

TOIL (subs.): I Labour:(1) pariSramaH, the t. of going to a hermitage: tapovanagamanapariSramaH, Sa. 1.;(2) kleSaH, t. when fruitful is no t.: saPalaH kle So na kle SaH, M.n. on Ku. v. 36.;(3) AyAsaH: v. Fatigue.II A net: q. v.: jAlam.
TOIL (v.): pariSramaM or kleSaM karoti: v. To labour.
To TOIL , v. n. Ayas, Sram, kliS. See To LABOUR, DRUDGE, FAG.
TOIL , s. AyAsaH, kleSaH, SramaH, kazwa. See LABOR, DRUDGERY.
Toilet, s. prasADanaM, maMqanaM.
TOILET: BUzA, vi-, Ki. ix. 1.: v. Dress, orna- -ment.

TOILET , s. (Act or mode of dressing) vastramAlyAdivinyAsaH, vastra- mAlyAdiracanA, aNgasaMskAraH, maRqanaM, nepaTyaM, BUzaRaM; ‘he makes his toilet,’ nepaTyaM DArayati, vastravinyAsaM karoti; ‘one who has finished her toilet,’ avasitamaRqanA; ‘toilet-table,’ BUzaRADAraH; ‘cover,’ BUzaRADArAcCAdanaM.
TOILSOME: (1) kazwakara (f. rI);(2) kazwasAvya (f. DyA);(3) kleSakara (f. rI), etc.
TOILSOME , a. kazwasADyaH -DyA -DyaM, SramasADyaH &c. See LABORIOUS.
Token, s. cihnaM, lakzaRaM.
TOKEN: cihnam: v. Mark, sign.
TOKEN , s. lakzaRaM, cihnaM, aBijYAnaM, saNketaH, see SIGN, MEMENTO.
TOLA , s. (Indian weight for gold and silver) tolaH -laM, tolakaH -kaM.

TOLD , p. p. kaTitaH -tA -taM, AKyAtaH &c., samAKyAtaH &c., uktaH -ktA -ktaM, BaRitaH -tA -taM, AveditaH &c., niveditaH &c., jYApitaH -tA -taM, jYapitaH &c., KyApitaH &c., jYaptaH -ptA -ptaM, sandizwaH -zwA -zwaM.
TOLERABLE: I Lit.:(1) sahya (f. hyA);(2) sahanIya (f. yA);(3) soQavya (f. vyA).II Moderately good: perh. nAtimanda (f. ndA: comp. Bengali).
TOLERABLE , a. (Bearable) sahanIyaH -yA -yaM, sahyaH -hyA -hyaM, soQavya -vyA -vyaM. — (Moderately good) viguRaH -RA -RaM, maDyamaguRaH -Ra -RaM, maDyamaH -mA -maM.
TOLERABLY: t. good or clever: nAtimanda (f. ndA); t. cold: nAtigrIzma (f. zmA); etc.
TOLERABLY , adv. viguRaM, yAvattAvat, kalpa or deSIya or deSya in comp.; ‘tolerably clever,’ pawukalpaH -lpA -lpaM, pawudeSIyaH &c.
TOLERANCE , s. sahanaM, sahizRutA, kzamA. See TOLERATION.
TOLERANT , a. sahanaH -nA -naM, sahizRuH -zRuH -zRu, anizeDakArI -riRI -ri (n), apratibanDakArI &c. See PATIENT, INDULGENT.
TOLERATE: (1) sahate (sah, c. 1.): v. To bear;(2) kzamate (kzam, c. 1.).
To TOLERATE , v. a. sah, vizah, kzam, mfz, tij in des., upekz, anizeDaM kf, apratibanDaM kf, anivAraRaM kf. See To SUFFER, PERMIT.
TOLERATED , p. p. anizidDaH -dDA -dDaM, anivAritaH -tA -taM, upekzitaH &c.
TOLERATION: (1) kzamA;(2) titikzA: v. For- -giveness.
TOLERATION , s. kzamA, kzAntiH f., titikzA, sahizRutA, anizeDaH, ani- vAraRaM, apratibanDaH, upekzA, apratiroDaH, aniroDaH.
Toll, v. t. (GaMwAM &c.) vad c., kvaR c.; See Sound. v. i. SanEH kvaR 1 P. s. SulkaH-lkaM; karaH; ‘t(oll)-collector’ SOlkikaH, SulkagrAhin. m.
TOLL (v.): DIraM vAdayati: v. To sound.
TOLL (subs.): (1) Sulka (mn.), t.-collector: SOlkikaH;(2) karaH (=tax).
TOLL , s. SulkaH -lkaM, tArikaM, tAryyaM, GawwAdideyaM, karaH. See TAX.
To TOLL , v. a. (A bell) SanEH SanEH or vAraM vAraM GaRwAM vad in caus.
To TOLL , v. n. (As a bell) SanEH SanEH or vAraM vAraM kvaRitaM kf.
TOLL-BOOTH: I Lit.: SulkasTAnam and sim. comp.s.II Prison: kArA.
TOLL-BOOTH , TOLL-HOUSE, s. SulkasTAnaM, SulkagrahaRasTAnaM.
TOLL-GATHERER , s. SOlkikaH, SulkagrAhI m. (n), karagrAhI m.
TOM-TOM , s. mfdaNgaH, pawahaH, dunduBiH m., qiRqimaH. See DRUM.
TOMATO: vijAtIya- or vilAtIya-hiRqariH.
TOMATO , s. hiRqIraH, hiNgulI, vaNganaH. See EGG-PLANT.
Tomb, s. samADiH, -sTAnaM; ‘t(omb)-stone’ cEtyaM.
TOMB: samADiH. T.-stone: samADiPalakam (?).
TOMB , s. samADiH m., SmaSAnaM, stUpaH, pretakuRqaM. See GRAVE.
TOMB-STONE , s. cityaM, cEtyaM, citAcUqakaM. See GRAVE-STONE.
Tome, s. (graMTasya) KaMqaH, BAgaH.
To-morrow, adv. SvaH, paredyuH, paredyavi; ‘day after t(o-morow)’ paraSvaH; ‘of t(o-morow)’ Svastana (nI f.).
TOMORROW: (1) SvaH, day after t.: paraSvaH: t. morning: SvaH praBAte, Ram.; of t.: SvastanaH (nI, naM) or Svastya (f. styA);(2) kalyam (also = yesterday).
Tomtom, s. pawahaH, BerI.
TOMTOM: I A drum: q. v.: qiRqimaH.II A cart: yAnaviSezaH.
Ton, s. SizwAcAraH. 2 wanaH (parimARaviSezaH).
TON: mAnaviSezaH, expr. with BaRaH (about 80 lbs.).
TON , s. saByAcAraH, saByarItiH f., saByasampradAyaH, SizwAcAraH.

Tone, s. svaraH, svanaH, nAdaH, DvaniH, ravaH, SabdaH; See Sound. 2 BAvaH, cezwA, cezwitaM. 3 (In music) svaraH; ‘long t(one)’ tAnaH; ‘keep a protracted t(one)’ tAnaM pradA 3 U, (udgAsyatAmicCati kinnarARAM tAnapradAyitvamivopa-gaMtuM K. i. 8). 4 (Of body) balaM, ArogyaM, svAsTyaM, susTatA, agniH. v. t. (down) mfdUkf 8 U, snigDIkf; pAruzyaM apanI 1 P. Tonic, s. balyaM, vAjIkaraRaM, bala-varDanaM, agnidaM, rocakaM, dIpanaM; kzIRabalIya-vAjIkaraRacikitsA ‘administering t(onic)s to persons reduced in strength’. a. vAjIkara (rI f.), balavarDana.

TONE (subs.): I Voice: q. v.: svaraH.II Manner:(1) BAvaH;(2) cezwA or cezwitam, D. viii.III In music: svaram, quarter t.: SrutiH, Si. xi. 1.IV Of the body: balam: v. Strength.V In painting: Ojjvalyam.

TONE , s. (Sound, note) svaraH, nAdaH, DvaniH m., virAvaH, viribDaH, see SOUND; ‘having a good tone,’ susvaraH -rA -raM. — (Musical sound) svaraH, kvaRaH, kvARaH, kvaRanaM, nikvaRaH, nikvARaH; ‘of a lute,’ prakvaRaH, prakvARaH. — (Seventh part of a scale) mUrcCanaM -nA; ‘half tone,’ svarAMSaH; ‘quarter tone,’ SrutiH f. — (In medicine) suBA- vanA, sadBAvanA, sadBAvaH, tejas n., agniH m.
Tongs, s. kaMkamuKaM, saMdaMSaH.
TONGS: (1) saMdaSakaH;(2) kaNkamuKaH.
TONGS , s. pl. sandaMSaH, sandaMSakaM -kA, kaNkamuKaH.
Tongue, s. jihvA, rasa(Sa)nA, rasajYA; ‘hold the t(ongue)’ See Hold; ‘t(ongue) of a bell’ lolA. 2 vARI, BAzA; See Language; ‘t(ongue)-tied’ badDa-niyaMtrita-jihva.

TONGUE: I Lit.: jihvA, I cannot hold my t.: na SaknomyAtmano jihvAM DArayitum,V ii.: I cannot keep my t.: jihvAM rakzituM na Saknomi, V. ii.; I have controlled (my) t. in such a way: evaM mayA jihvA saMyantritA,V ii.;(2) raSa(sa)nA, the Vedas were on the tip of his t.: tasya kila CandAMsi rasanAgre, D. vii.II Speech, language: q. v.: vAc, in human t.: manusyavAcA, R. ii. 33.

TONGUE , s. jihvA, rasanA, rasajYA, raSanA, rasikA, rasAlA, rasanaM, lalanA, lolA, jihvaH, visvAsA, muKacIrI; ‘root of the tongue,’ jihvAmUlaM; ‘tip of it,’ jihvAgraM; ‘that is on the tip of it,’ jihvArUQaH -QA -QaM; ‘hold your tongue,’ vAcaM niyacCa, tUzRImBavaH ‘tongue-scraper,’ see SCRAPER; ‘one of the seven tongues of fire,’ sPuliNginI; ‘tongue of a bell,’ lolA; ‘of a bolt,’ [Page807-a+ 51] kaRwakaH. — (Speech) BAzA; ‘mother-tongue,’ janmaBAzA.
TONGUE-LESS , a. ajihvaH -hvA -hvaM, jihvAhInaH -nA -naM, nirjihvaH &c.
TONGUE-TIED , a. badDajihvaH -hvA -hvaM, saMyantritajihvaH &c., yatajihvaH &c.

TONIC (adj. and subs.): (1) sarvadozaharaH (rI, raM) (=remover of all disorder of the system), Sr.;(2) meDAgnibalavarDanaH (nI, naM) (=improving memory, appetite, and strength), Sr.; (4) balya (f. lyA = strengthening), Bha.
TONIC , a. rucakaH -kA -kaM, rocakaH &c., tejaskaraH -rA -raM, dIpakaH &c., agnivarDakaH &c., agnidaH -dA -daM, pAcakaH -kA -kaM, dIpanaH -nA -naM.
TONIC , s. rucakaM, rocakaH, agnivarDanaH -naM, pAcakaM, dIpanaM.
TONNAGE: expr. with BAraH (=weight, bur- -den: q. v.).
Tonsil, s. jihvAmUlasTaH, mAMsagraMTiH.
TONSIL: kaRWasnotasa (?), Bha.
TONSIL , s. kaRWAntarvarttI SrepmAdyASayo mfdumAMsapiRqaH; ‘enlargement of them,’ aDimAMsakaH, SataGnI, gaRqamAlA.
Tonsure, s. kzOraM, muMqanaM, keSavapanaM, cUqAsaMskAraH SiromaMqanaM; ‘t(onsure) ceremony’ cOlaM.

TONSURE , s. (Shaving the head) kzOraM, kzorakarmma n. (n), keSavapanaM, SirovapanaM, muRqanaM, SiromuRqanaM, keSaCedaH. — (As a sacred rite) cUqAkarmma n. (n), cUqAkaraRaM, cUqA, cOqaM, cOlaM, cOlakarmma n., cUqAlakzaRaM.
Too, adv. api, taTA, cEva. 2 ati or su pr.; atyaMtaM, atIva, BfSaM; See Exceedingly; sudIrGa, dIrGatara ‘t(oo) long’ &c.
TOO: I Also: q. v.: api, he t.: so'pi.II Very: ati- or su- in comp. t. long (of time): suciram, K.; t. long (of direction): sudIrGa (f. rGA), C.; t. great a load: atiBAraH, H.: v. Also excessively.

TOO , adv. (Over much) ati or su prefixed, atIva, atyantaM, ekA- ntatas, ekAnta in comp., see EXCESSIVELY; ‘too great a load,’ atiBAraH; ‘he approaches too near the fire,’ agner atisa- mIpam upasarpati; ‘too compassionate,’ atikaruRaH -RA -RaM, ekAntakaruRaH &c.; ‘too early,’ atiprage, atikalyaM; ‘too late in the evening,’ atisAyaM -ye; ‘too long,’ sudIrGaH -rGA -rGaM. — (Also) cEva, ca, api, taTA.

details.body: Tool, s. upakaraRaM, sADanaM, yaMtraM ‘a mere t(ool)’ yaMtramAtraM; ‘you are a t(ool) in the ministerʼs hands’ tvaM sarvaTA sacivAjYAnuvartI tena yaMtravat cAlyase.

TOOL: I Lit.:(1) upakaraRam, t. and apparatus of artisans: SilpinAM dravyopakaraRam, Mah. ii. 5. 128.; t. s by which he earns his livelihood: yad yad yasyopakaraRaM tena jIvanti jIvikAm, N. s.II Fig.: he is a mere t. in his hands: sa tena yantra- vaccAlyate.
TOOL , s. upakaraRaM, yantraM, sADanaM, SastraM, see INSTRUMENT; ‘a mere tool,’ nimittamAtraM, kAraRamAtraM, upakaraRamAtraM.

Tooth, s. daMtaH, daSanaH, radaH, radanaH, daMSaH, daMzwrA, dvijaH, jaMBaH; ‘two middle foreteeth’ rAjadaMtO; ‘double teeth’ mAQi f. 2 (Of a saw) daMtaH; ‘t(ooth)-picker’ daM-tasya nizkozaRaM, daMtolleKanI; SoDanI, nirGarzaRakaM; ‘t(ooth)-powder’ daMtaSoDana cUrRaM, daMta pavanaM; ‘t(ooth)-brush’ daMtapavanaM-kUrcakaM; ‘having good teeth’ sudat; ‘in the teeth of’ anAdftya (with acc.) or by abs. constr.; See ‘In spite of’ under Spite, ‘in the teeth of the Vedas’ vedezu jAgarUkezu satsu Apa. [Tooth]ed, a. daMta, dat in comp. [Tooth]less, a. daMtahIna, galitadaMta, nirdaMta-nIrada, Bagna-udDfta-daMzwra. [Tooth]some, a. svAdu. Teething, s. daMtodBedaH, daMtodgamaH.

TOOTH: (1) dantaH, “skin of t.: dantavezwaH”, Sr.; white t. ed: SuBradanta (f. ntI). Ph.: t.-powder: dantaSoDanacUrRam, Sr.; t. picker: dantasya nirGarzaRakam, H.; ii.; having fine teeth: sudat (f. tI), R.; (2) daSana (mn.), marks of teeth: daSanacihnam, Si.; (3) radaH (rare), row of teeth: radAvalI, Ku. [Page716] xvii. 43. Ph.: on the teeth of: i. e. in spite of: expr. with gen. or loc.: on the teeth of the Vedas: vedezu jAgarUkezu, D. s.; in the teeth of us: mizatAM naH, Ku. ii. 46.

TOOTH , s. dantaH, daSanaH -naM, radaH, radanaH, daMSaH, daMzwrA, svAdanaH, dAQA, dvijaH, dvijanmA m. (n), muKajaH, CadvaraH, dandaSaH, jamBaH, hAluH m., svaruH m., vaktraKuraH, rucakaH, mallakaH, PawaH; ‘a row of teeth,’ danta- paMktiH f., dantAvalI, see TEETH; ‘two middle fore teeth,’ rAja- dantO m. du.; ‘double tooth,’ mAQiH f.; ‘decay of a tooth,’ dvijavraRaH. — (Of a saw, comb, wheel, &c.) dantaH.
TOOTH-ACHE , s. dantavedanA, dantavyaTA, dantaSUlaH, dAlanaM.
TOOTH-BRUSH: (1) kurcakam or dantaDAvanakurcakam, Sr.;(2) dantapAvanam, Sr.
TOOTH-BRUSH , s. dantaDAvanaM, dantakAzWaM, kUrccakaM.
TOOTH-PICK , s. dantaSoDanI, SalAkA, dantanirGarzaRakaH.
TOOTH-POWDER , s. dantapavanaM, dantaSARaM, niScukkaRaM. See DENTIFRICE.
TOOTHED , a. dantI -ntinI -nti (n), radI &c., dantajAtaH -tA -taM, danta or dan &c. in comp.; as, ‘handsome-toothed,’ sudan -datI dat (t); ‘iron-toothed,’ ayodantaH -ntA -ntaM, ayodan &c.
TOOTHLESS: (1) dantahIna (f. nA);(2) vItadanta (f. ntA); etc.

TOOTHLESS , a. adantaH -ntA -ntaM, nirdantaH &c., dantahInaH -nA -naM, nirdaSanaH -nA -naM, gatadantaH -ntA -ntaM, galitadantaH &c., nIradaH -dA -daM, adaMzwrI -zwriRI -zwri (n), BagnadaMzwraH -zwrA -zwraM, udDftadaMzwraH &c., daSanocCizwaH -zwA -zwaM.
TOOTHSOME: svAdu (f. also dvI): v. Palatable, tasty.

Top, s. agraM, SiKara, SfMgaM, sAnu m. n., SiKA, cUqA, Siras n., SIrzakaM, mUrDan m., mastakaM. 2 BramaraM. 3 piDAnaM, AcCAdanaM, puwaM. 4 muKya-SrezWa-sTAnaM; ‘he stands at the t(op) of the class’ sarvezAM bAlakAnAM mUrDni tizWatiH ‘t(op)-heavy’ urDvaguru; ‘t(op)-knot’ cUqA, SiKA, SiKaMqaH, SeKaraH. a. muKya, uparisTa, agra in comp.; ‘t(op)-most branch’, agraSAKA. v. t. Ex. by (s.); ‘t(opp)ed with snow’ tuhinAvftaSiKara. 2 Excel, q. v.; See (s.) also.
TOP (subs.): I Tip, peak: q. v.: agram; (2) SiKaram, from the top of a tree: taruSiKarAt, K.II A playing t.: Bramaram.
TOP (adj.): (1) agra- in comp., in the t.-most summit: agrasAnuzu, Ki. ix. 7.: v. First;(2) muKya (f. KyA): v. Chief;(3) SrezWa (f. zWA); : v. Superior, excellent.
TOP (v.): I Lit.: v. Top (subs.), to cover, put. Ph.: t.ed with white clouds: SvetameGakftaSIrza (f. rzA.), Mat. 116. 5.II Overcome, sur- -pass: q. v.: atikrAmati (kram, c. 1.).

TOP , s. (Highest part, upper end) agraM, SiKA, SiKaraM, agraBAgaH, pfzwaM, SfNgaM, cUqA, Siras n., upariBAgaH, SIrzakaM, mastakaM, tuNgaH, nIcakI m. (n); ‘of a tree,’ vfkzAgraM, vfkzaSiras n.; ‘fallen from the top of a tree,’ vfkzAgrAt patitaH; ‘of a palace or house,’ prAsAda- pfzWaM, gfhapfzWaM; ‘of a mountain,’ giriSfNgaM, giripfzWaM, prAgBAvaH. — (Lid) piDAnaM. — (Highest or chief place) muKyasTAnaM. — (Spin- ning top) BramaraM, BramarakrIqanakaM.
TOP , a. (in comp.) uparisTaH -sTA -sTaM, agrasTaH -sTA -sTaM.
TOP-HEAVY , a. BArADikaSiraskaH -skA -skaM, UrdDvaguruH -ruH -ru.
TOP-KNOT: cUqA: v. Crest.
TOP-KNOT , s. cUqA, SiKA, SiKaRqaH -RqakaH, SiKaraH -raM, SeKaraH.
Topaz, s. pItASman m., puzparAgaH.
TOPAZ: (1) puzparAgaH;(2) pItasAraH;(3) pItAman (m.) and sim. comp. s.
TOPAZ , s. pItASmA m. (n), pItasPawikaH, pItamaRiH m., pItasAraH, pItaraktaM, pItaH, puzparAgaH, padmarAgaH, gururatnaM.
Tope, s. stUpaH. v. i. madyAtipAnaM kf 8 U. [Tope]r, s. madyAsaktaH.
TOPE: I Buddhist: stUpaH.II Of trees:(1) stUpaH;(2) PkAwaH.
TOPE , s. (Mound of earth) stUpaH.
Topic, s. vizayaH, arTaH, prastAvaH; prakaraRaM, vastu n.
TOPIC: vizayaH: v. Subject.
TOPIC , s. vizayaH, prakaraRaM, prasaNgaH, prasaktiH f., vfttAntaH, padaM. See SUBJECT.
TOPIC , TOPICAL, a. prAkaraRikaH -kI -kaM, viSezasTAnikaH -kI -kaM.
TOPMOST , a. sarvvoparisTaH -sTA -sTaM, sarvvAgrasTaH &c., agratamaH -mA -maM.
Topography, s. sTAnavarRanaM.
TOPOGRAPHY: saMsTAnavarRanam, -nA (?) and sim. comp. s.
TOPOGRAPHY , s. vizeSasTAnavarRanaM, viSezasTalavivaraRaM, sTAnavarRanaM.
Topple, v. i. (SiKarAt) sahasA pat 1 P or avapat.
TOPPLE: patati (pat, c. 1.): v. To fall.
To TOPPLE , v. n. UrdDvagurutvAd agrataH pat (c. 1. patati -tituM).
TOPSY-TURVY , a. or adv. aDarottaraH -rA -raM, UrdDvADaraH -rA -raM.
Topsyturvy, adv. viparyasta a.; aDarottara a.
TOPSYTURVY: (1) astavyasta (f. stA);(2) viparyasta (f. stA).
Torch, s. ulkA, ulmukaM, dIpikA, agnikAzWaM.
TORCH: (1) ulkA, moved about with t. es in their hands: ulkAhastO viceratuH, Ram. vi. 53. 7.; with hundreds of lighted t.es: ulkASatEH prajvalitEH, Mah.;(2) ulmukam (rare).
TORCH , s. ulkA, jvalanakAzWaM, agnikAzWaM, ulmukaM, aNgAraM, alAtaM, agni- kukkawaH, kaRwanIlakaH.
TORCH-BEARER , s. ulkADArI m. (n), ulkAvAhI m. -vAhakaH.

Torment, v. t. (atyaMtaM) ard 1 P or c., pIq 10, saMtap c., saM-, bAD 1 A, kliS 9 P, Ayas c., vipra-kf 8 U, pramaMT 9 P; See Afflict. s. (atyaMta-)AtaMkaH, saMtApaH, vyaTA, pIqA, duHKaM, vedanA, yAtanA; kAraRA, dAruRa-tIvra-tigma-yAtanA-vedanA. [Torment]ing, a. pramATin, aruMtuda, AyAsakArin. [Torment]or, s. atipIqakaH, pramATin m., AyAsakaH, saMtApakaH.
TORMENT (v.): (1) KalIkaroti, this man is t.ed by the head gambler: ayaM saBikena KalIkriyate, Mr. ii.;(2) bADate: v. To vex, trouble, pain.
TORMENT (subs.): (1) yAtanA;(2) yantraRA;(3) kAraRA.

To TORMENT , v. a. atyantaM pIq (c. 10. pIqayati -yituM) or tap (c. 10. tApayati -yituM) or santap or paritap, yat (c. 10. yAtayati -yituM), atIva vyaT (c. 10. vyaTayati -yituM), atiSayena bAD (c. 1. bADate -DituM) or kliS, atiyAtanAM kf or dA, ativedanAM kf or dA, tIvravedanAM kf or dA, ativyaTAM kf or dA, paramaduHKaM kf, viqamb (c. 10. -qambayati -yituM). See To HARASS, VEX, ANNOY.

TORMENT , s. (Extreme pain) yAtanA, atiyAtanA, ativedanA, ati- vyaTA, atiduHKaM, atipIqA, tIvravedanA, tigmavedanA, tigmayAtanA, atikleSaH, paramaduHKaM, dAruRaduHKaM, dAruRayAtanA, yamayAtanA, tApaH, pari- tApaH, yantraRaM -RA, viqambanaM -nA, kleSaH, duHKaM. — (That which gives annoyance) kaRwakaH.
TORMENTED , p. p. atipIqitaH -tA -taM, ativyaTitaH &c., atibADitaH &c., viqambitaH -tA -taM, karzitaH -tA -taM, tunnaH -nnA -nnaM, duHKadagDaH -gDA -gDaM.

TORMENTING , TORMENTER, a. and s. atipIqakaH -kA -kaM, atipI- qAjanakaH &c., atikleSakaraH -rI -raM, atiduHKakaraH &c., aruntudaH -dA -daM, pramATI -TinI &c., AyAsakArI &c., pariklezwA -zwI -zwf (zwf).

TORN , p. p. vidAritaH -tA -taM, vidIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, dAritaH -tA -taM, pravi- dAritaH &c., dIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, dalitaH -tA -taM, vidalitaH &c., pAwitaH -tA -taM, BinnaH -nnA -nnaM; ‘with the nails,’ naKaBinnaH -nnA -nnaM; ‘being torn,’ vidIryyamARaH -RA -RaM; ‘having torn,’ vidAryya; ‘is torn,’ vidIryyate.
Tornado, s. GUrRavAyuH.
TORNADO: GUrRavAyuH and sim. comp. s.: v. Storm, wind.
TORNADO , s. GUrRavAtaH, GUrRavAyuH m., praBaYjanaH. See TEMPEST.
TORPEDO: I a fish: *vEdyutakaH.II An engine: *pramATinI.
Torpid, a. jaqa; supta, vicetana. 2 maMda, jaqa; See Dull, Slow. [Torpid]ity, Torpor, s. jAqyaM, supti f., cEtanyanASaH, svApaH, mAMdyaM, taMdrA, jaqiman m.
TORPID: jaqa (f. qA): v. Numb, slow, in- -active.
TORPID , a. jaqaH -qA -qaM, vicetanaH -nA -naM, suptaH &c., see NUMB.
TORPIDITY, TORPOR: jAqyam: v. Numbness, slowness.
TORPOR , TORPIDITY, s. jaqatA, jAqyaM, jaqimA m. (n), cEtanyastamBaH, cEtanyanASaH, suptiH f., svApaH, mAndyaM, kuRWatA, tandrA. See NUMBNESS.

Torrent, s. srotas n., rayaH, vegaH, oGaH. 2 jalapravAhaH-prapAtaH, nirJaraH, prasravaRaM; nadI. 3 DArA, AsAraH; ‘t(orrent)s of rain’ DArAsaMpAtaH, DArAsAraH, vfzwiDArA; DArAsArErmahatI vfzwirbaBUva ‘it rained in t(orrent)s’.
TORRENT: I Of rain etc.:(1) DArA;(2) AsAraH: v. Rain.II Stream: q. v.: srotas (n.): v. Also flow.

TORRENT , s. nirJaraH -rI, JaraH, jalapravAhaH, jalaprapAtaH, jalaDArA, oGaH, jalOGaH, prasravaRaM, srotas n., JA; ‘of rain,’ vfzwiDArA, DArA- sAraH, DArAsampAtaH, tarantaH; ‘a mountain torrent,’ girinadI, girisarit.
Torrid, a. uzRa; See Hot.
TORRID: uzRa (f. zRA): v. Hot.
TORRID , a. uzRadagDaH -gDA -gDaM, grIzmadagDaH &c.; ‘zone,’ uzRakawibanDaH.
Tortoise, s. kUrmaH, kamaWaH, kacCapaH; ‘female of a t(ortoise)’ kUrmI, kamaWI, quliH.
TORTOISE: (1) kUrmaH;(2) kacCapaH;(3) kamaWaH. Ph.: t. -shell: kamaWapfzWam, Ma. n.

TORTOISE , s. kUrmmaH, kacCapaH, kamaWaH, kAmaWaH, gUQANgaH, paYcANgaguptaH, paYcaguptaH, kaWinapfzWaM, caturgatiH m., kroqapAdaH, udBawaH, smaraRApatyatarpakaH; ‘female,’ kUrmmI, kacCapI, kamaWI, duliH -lI f., duliH f.; ‘re- lating to a tortoise,’ kOrmmaH -rmmI -rmmaM, kAmaWaH -WI -WaM.
TORTOISE-SHELL , s. kUrmmakavacaH -caM, kUrmmakambuH -mbu m. n., kUrmmapfzWaM, kOrmmaM.
TORTUOSITY , s. vakratA, vakrimA m. (n), kuwilatvaM, jihmatA, tiryyaktraM.
Tortuous, a. vakra, kuwila, jihma, tiryac. [Tortuous]ly, adv. vakraM, tiryak-kuwila in comp.
TORTUOUS: vakra (f. krA): v. Crooked.

TORTUOUS , a. vakraH -krA -kraM, kuwilaH -lA -laM, tiryyaN -raScI -ryyak (Yc); ‘moving tortuously,’ tiryyaggAmI -minI &c., kuwilagAmI &c., dandramaRaH -RA -RaM; ‘movement,’ caNkramA -maRaM, dandramaM -maRaM.
Torture, v. t. yat c., atyaMtaM pIq 10, pra-maMT 9 P; See Torment.
TORTURE (subs.): yAtanA; (2) kAraRA (rare), of the eighteen t.s: azwAdaSAnAM kAraRAnAm, D. ii.
TORTURE (v.): yAtanAM or kAraRAM dadAti (dA, c. 3.): v. Also to pain, torment.
To TORTURE , v. a. yat (c. 10. yAtayati -yituM), yAtanayantreRa vyaT or pramaT (c. 10. -mATayati -yituM), yAtanAM kf, atyantaM pIq &c., See To TORMENT.
TORTURE , s. yAtanA, ativyaTA, vyaTA, pramATaH, vyADiH m., ativyADiH m., [Page808-a+ 51] tigmavyaTA, tigmavedanA, sampIqaH, udvejanaM. See TORMENT.
TORTURED , p. p. vyaTitaH -tA -taM, santaptaH -ptA -ptaM, pramaTitaH -tA -taM.
TORTURER: (1) yAtanAdAyin (f. nI);(2) by circumlo.
TORTURER , s. yAtanAkArI m. (n), yAtanakft m., vyaTAkaraH, pramATI m. (n), udvejanakaraH, santApakaH, pariklezwA m. (zwf). See TORMENTING.

Toss, v. t. ut-vi-kzip 6 P, vyudas 4 U. ud-DU 5, 9 U, saMkzuB c.; See Throw, v. i. vikzip-udDU- pass., itastataH vical 1 P or luw 6 P or lul 1 P or plu 1 A, GUrR 6 P, 1 A. s. ut-kzepaH-paRaM; sa-vyA-kzoBaH.
TOSS (v.): I Trans.: vikzipati (kzip, c. 6.): v. To throw about, scatter, roll.II In- -trans.:(1) vikzipyate (pass. of kzip);(2) itastataH syandate (syand, c. 1.): v. Also to roll.
TOSS (subs.): (1) utkzepaH -Ram, saM-;(2) kzepaH: v. Throw.
To TOSS , v. a. kzip (c. 6. kzipati, kzeptuM), vikzip, utkzip, samutkzip, kzuB (c. 10. kzoBayati -yituM), vikzuB, saMkzuB, udDU (c. 5. -DUnoti -DotuM), viDU.

To TOSS , v. n. vikzip in pass. (-kzipyate), itastato vikzip or vical (c. 1. -calati -lituM) or pracal, itastato luW (c. 6. luWati -WituM) or praluW or lul, GUrR (c. 1. GUrRati -te -rRituM), viGUrR, vyAGUrR, pariGUrR, udDU in pass. (-DUyate), viDU, itastataH plu (c. 1. plavate, plotuM).
TOSS , s. kzepaH -paRaM, utkzepaH -paRaM, samutkzepaH, kzoBaH, vyAkzoBaH.

TOSSED , p. p. kziptaH -ptA -ptaM, utkziptaH &c., kzubDaH -bDA -bDaM, saMkzubDaH &c., udDUtaH -tA -taM, viDUtaH &c., vyastaH -stA -staM, praloWitaH -tA -taM, udBrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, vikziptaH &c., vikIryyamARaH -RA -RaM, kAlyamAnaH &c.
TOSSING , s. kzepaRaM, utkzepaRaM, hallanaM. See ROLLING, s. and part.

Total, a. sakala, sarva, samagra, saMpUrRa, &c.; See Whole; ‘t(otal) rout’ atyaMtanASaH, supalAyitaM; ‘t(otal) disorder’ atyaMtamAkulaM. [Total]ity, s. sAkalyaM, samazwi f., EkyaM, kArtsnyaM; ‘what is the t(otality)’ evaM sarve (piMqIkftya) kati saMpadyaMte. [Total]ly, adv. saMpUrRaM, sAkalyena, sarvaTAtaH, aSezeRa, niHSezaM.
TOTAL (adj.): (1) sakala (f. lA), t. number of lotuses: sakalakamalasaMKyA, Li. 28.;(2) samagra (f. grA): v. All, whole.
TOTAL, TOTALITY (subs.): (1) sAkalyam;(2) samazwiH;(3) Ekyam, Li. 85.
TOTAL , a. sampUrRaH -rRA -rRaM, pUrRaH &c., samagraH -grA -graM, AtyantikaH -kI -kaM, see ENTIRE, COMPLETE; ‘total rout,’ supalAyitaM.
TOTAL , TOTALITY, s. sAkalyaM, samudAyaH, samastiH f., samAsaH, sAmagryaM, EkyaM, pArAyaRaM, kArtsnaM, samAmnAyaH. See WHOLE, s.
TOTALLY: sampUrRam: v. Fully, wholly.
TOTALLY , adv. sarvvatas, sarvvaSas, samyak, sAkalyena. See ENTIRELY.
Totter, v. pra-, sKal 1 P, kaMp 1 A, vi-cal 1 P; See Shake. [Totter]ing, a. sKalita, sKalita-vihvala-gati.
TOTTER: hvalati, pra-, vi- (hval, c. 1.): v. Wa- -ver, stagger.
To TOTTER , v. n. sKal (c. 1. sKalati -lituM), prasKal, vical (c. 1. -calati -lituM), saMcal, cal, vihval (c. 1. -hvalati -lituM), prahval, hval.
TOTTERING , part. sKalitaH -tA -taM, vicalan -lantI -lat (t), sKali- tagatiH -tiH -ti, viklavagatiH &c., sKaladgatiH &c., calavicalaH -lA -laM.

Touch, v. t. saM-, spfS 6 P, (fig. also); parAmfS 6 P, hastena AlaB 1 A; SatasaMKyA tu mAmiyaM spfSati (Ve. 2) ‘t(ouch)es me home’; ‘was t(ouch)ed to the heart’ hfdaye (digDaSarEriva) AhataH (R. v. 25); ‘heart t(ouch)ed with anxiety’ hfdayaM saMspfzwa-mutkaMWayA (S. 4). 2 (On, upon) uddiSya-aDikftya-vad 1 P (‘Say’, q. v.). v. i. saMsargaM-saMparkaM-i 2 P or gam 1 P. s. saM-, sparSaH-rSanaM, parAmarSaH, AlaMBanaM, saMsargaH, saMparkaH. 2 sparSaboDaH-jYAnaM. 3 sparSaH, sparSeM-driyaM; ‘t(ouch)-stone’ ni-, kazaH, nikazagrAvan m. -pAzARaH, upalaH, SARaH; ‘adversity is the t(ouch)-stone of (the sincerity of) friendship’ tezAM (mitrARAM) tattvanikazagrAvA vipat (H. 1). [Touch]ing, prep. uddiSya, aDi-kftya; See About. a. hfdayaMgama, hfdispfS; See Pathetic. [Touch]y, a. kopana, caMqakopa, SIGra-sulaBa-kopa.

TOUCH (v.): (1) spfSati, rarely with pari- or saM- (spfS, c. 6.), you t. her eyes: dfzwiM spfSasi, Sa. i. 24.; this will not t. me: na mAM spfSedayam, Mah.;(2) by subs., what can be t.ed: sparSavat (f. tI), Par. 56.: v. Also affect, feel.
To TOUCH , v. a. spfS (c. 6. spfSati, sprazwuM), saMspfS, parispfS, hastena parAmfS or AlaB, sparSaM kf. See To HANDLE, MOVE.
To TOUCH , v. n. (Come in contact) samparkam i or gam, saMsargam i or gam, parasparasparSaM kf; ‘as a vessel,’ lag (c. 1. lagati -gituM).

TOUCH , s. (The sense) sparSaH, spfzwiH f., sparSendriyaM. — (The percep- tion, the act of touching) sparSaH -rSanaM, saMsparSaH, parimarSaH, pari- mArgaH, sparSaboDaH, sparSajYAnaM, tvagjYAnaM. — (Contact) samparkaH, pfktiH f., saMsparSaH, saMsargaH, see CONTACT. — (Touch as a test of gold) varRakA.
TOUCH AT, TOUCH ON or UPON: spfSati: v. To touch.
TOUCH-ME-NOT: a plant: latAviSezaH.
TOUCH-STONE , s. nikazaH, kazaH, nikazapAzARaH, kazapAzARaH, nikaza- grAvA m. (n), AkazaH, nikasaH, kasaH, SARaH, SAnaH, hemalaH.

TOUCHED , p. p. spfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, saMspfzwaH &c., see MOVED; ‘my heart is touched with grief,’ utkaRWayA saMspfzwaM hfdayaM; ‘to be touched,’ sprazwavyaH -vyA -vyaM, spfSyaH -SyA -SyaM, sparSanIyaH -yA -yaM.
TOUCHING: I Adj.: hfdayaspfS (mfn.): v. Pathetic.II = about: q. v.: uddiSya.
TOUCHING , a. hfdayaNgamaH -mA -maM. See MOVING, PATHETIC, a.
TOUCHSTONE: kazaH, ni-, “kazapAzARaniBe naBastale”, N.
TOUCHY: kopana (f. nA): v. Irritable, peevish.
TOUCHY , a. SIGrakopI -pinI &c. See IRRITABLE, PEEVISH.
Tough, a. kaWina, dfQa, durBedya.

TOUGH (subs.): sparSaH, -nam, or rarely spfzwiH, saM-, pari-; pleasure of t.: sparSasuKam, Ki.; admit- [Page717] -ting of t.: sparSakzam (f. mA), Sa. i. 29.; t. ing my feet: matpAdaspfzwikayA, Vi. iv.: v. Also contact.
TOUGH: (1) kaWina (f. nA=hard);(2) dfQa (f. QA= firm);(3) guru (f. also rvI=heavy: as of meat), Bha.
TOUGH , a. dfQaH -QA -QaM, duHKaBedyaH -dyA -dyaM, durBedyaH &c., duHKaCedyaH &c., duSCedyaH &c., duHKaCinnaH -nnA -nnaM, kaWinaH -nA -naM, SiTiladfQaH &c.
TOUGHNESS: (1) kAWinyam: v. Hardness;(2) dfQatA or dArQyam: v. Firmness;(3) guruttvam: v. Heaviness.
TOUGHNESS , s. dfQatA, durBedyatA, duHKaCedyatA, kaWinatA, kAWinyaM.
Tour, s. pari-BramaRaM; paryawanaM; ‘he is on t(our)’ svamaMqale carati-Bramati; ‘make a t(our)’ pari-Bram 1, 4 P. [Tour]ist, s. paryawakaH.
TOUR: pariBramaRam: v. Travel.
TOUR , s. BramaRaM, pariBramaRaM, paryawanaM, vihAraH, viharaRaM.
TOURIST: (1) pariBramaRakArin (f. RI);(2) paryawaka (f. wikA); etc.
TOURIST , s. pariBramakaH, BramaRakArI m. (n), BramaRakft, vihArI m.
Tournament, s. sAdikrIqA-yudDaM.
TOURNAMENT: sAdinAM niyudDam or krIqAyudDam (?).
TOURNAMENT , TOURNEY, s. aSvArohiRAM krIqAyudDaM.
Tow, v. t. kfD 1 P, Akfzya saMcal c. s. sTUlaSARaM, SaRasUtraM.
TOW: I Verb: karzati (kfz, c. 1.): v. To drag.II Subs.: sTUlaSARam and sim. comp. s: v. Rope. Ph.: to take in t.: badDA nayati, (nI, c. 1.: comp. Bengali).
TOW , s. sTUlaSaRaM, SaRasUtraM, sTUlaBaNgA, SaRasTUlaM.
To TOW , v. a. rajjunA or rajnA kfz, rajjunA Akfzya cal in caus.

Toward, Towards, prep. prati (with acc.), aBi in comp.; by aBimuKa. a. (KI f.) or aBimuKaM. adv. in comp., (gfhABimuKaM pratasTe), uddiSya (with acc.). 2 (With words of direction) by loc. also, upari (with gen.); ‘t(owards) the north’ uttarasyAM diSi, uttarABimuKaM; ‘t(owards) me’ mamopari, mAM prati, mAmuddiSya, mayi. 3 prAyaH; ‘t(owards) evening’ aBisAyaM, sAyAhnakalpaM. a. See Forward; ‘un-t(owards)’ atarkita, asamarTitopanata.

TOWARD, TOWARDS: (1) prati in comp., t. Śiva: ISaM prati, Ku. v. 31.; t. the north-east: ESAnIM diSaM prati, V. i.;(2) aBi (gen. in comp.), t. evening: aBisAyam, Si. i. 16.; t. Ayodhyā: aByayoDyam, B. ii. 49.: v. Also to (VI).
TOWARD, TOWARDLY: anuviDAyin (f. nI): v. Compliant.

TOWARD , TOWARDS, adv. (In the direction of) prati, anu, aBimuKaM, uddiSya; ‘towards the city,’ nagaraM prati, nagarABimuKaM; ‘he set out towards the north,’ uttarAM diSatuddiSya prasTitaH. — (With [Page808-b+ 51] respect to) upari, uddiSya, uddeSena, prati affixed; ‘towards me,’ mamopari, mAmuddiSya, mAM prati; ‘want of courtesy towards you,’ tavopari adAkziRyaM; ‘not behaving properly towards his father,’ piturupari asadfSavyavahArI. — (Nearly) prAyas; ‘towards evening,’ aBisAyaM.
Towel, s. gAtramArjanI, mArjanavastraM.
TOWEL: gAtramArjanI and sim. comp. s.
TOWEL , s. gAtramArjanI, aNgamArjanI, gAtramArjanavastraM, varakaM.
Tower, s. awwaH, utseDaH; kzOmaH-maM (‘room on the t(ower)’). v. i. mUrDni vft 1 A or sTA 1 P. [Tower]ing, a. pronnata, procCrita, uttuMga.
TOWER (subs.): I Lit.: KawwaH (?).II Fig.: t. of strength: balopastamBaH.
TOWER (v.): upari tizWati (sTA, c. 1.): v. To stand, high.
TOWER , s. prAsAdaSiKaraM -SfNgaM, maYcaH f., durgaM. See TURRET.
TOWERING , a. pronnataH -tA -taM, unnataH -tA -taM. See ELEVATED.
TOWLINE: i. e. towing rope: guRaH (?).
Town, s. puraM, pur f., purI, nagaraM-rI, pattanaM (‘small t(own)’), puwaBedanaM, sTAnIyaM, nigamaH. Townsman, s. nAgarikaH, pOraH, -janaH (pOrI, pOravaDU f.).
TOWN: nagaram(rI); (2) puram(rI).
TOWN , s. nagaraM -rI, purI, see CITY; ‘town and country,’ purajanapadaM.
TOWN-FOLK , TOWNS-MAN, s. nagarajanaH, nagaranivAsijanaH. See CITIZEN.
TOWN-HALL , s. nagarakAryyanirvAhayogyA mahASAlA.
TOWNHALL: pOraSAlA (?) and sim. comp. s.
TOWNSMAN, TOWNSWOMAN: (1) nAgarika (f. kI);(2) pOra (f. rI);(3) pOrajanaH (f. vaDUH).
Toxic, a. vizasaMbaMDin. [Toxic]ology, vizavidyA.
Toy, s. krIqanakaM, kIqAdravyaM-vastu. v. i. krIq 1 P; See Play.
TOY: I Subs.: krIqanakam.II Verb.: v. To play, sport.
TOY , s. krIqanakaM, krIqAdravyaM, krIqAvastu n., KelanI, krIqAmfgaH.
TOY-SHOP , s. krIqAdravyavikrayasTAnaM, krIqAvastuvikrayagfhaM.

Trace, s. cihnaM, aMkaH, aBijYAnaM; See Mark. 2 (Of foot-steps) padavI, pada-padDati f.; See Footstep. 3 (Of carts) pragrahaH, carmabaMDaH. v. t. AliK 6 P, bAhya reKAM liK. 2 anu-sf 1 P, anu-DAv 1 P; mfg 10 A, anupadaM yA or gam. 3 (Out) A-sad c., grah 9 U, grAhakErgfhyate cOro loptreRATa padena vA (Y. ii. 266) ‘or is t(rac)ed out’ &c.; oft. by praBavaH (‘Source’ q. v.) ‘his sudden affluence has been t(rac)ed out’ tasyAkasmikaviBUteH praBava upa-labDaH. 4 (Word) vyutpad c.; ‘when the word Brahman is t(rac)ed (to its root)’; brahmaSabdasya vyutpAdyamAnasya (S. B. 33).
TRACE (v.): I To draw: q. v.: AliKati (liK, c. 6.).II With out: AsAdayati (c. of sad): v. To find out.
TRACE (subs.): I Mark: q. v.: cihnam.II Foot-print: q. v.: padavI.III Of a carriage: pragrahaH (grAhaH).
TRACE (subs.): I Mark: q. v.: cihnam.II Way: q. v.: mArgaH.
TRACE , s. aBijYAnaM, cihnaM, lakzaRaM, aNkaH, padavI, tattvaM, see MARK, FOOTSTEP. — (Of a carriage, &c.) pragrahaH, pragrAhaH, carmmabanDaH.
To TRACE , v. a. (Follow by some mark) anusf, mArgAnusaraRaM kf, vartmAnusaraRaM kf, mfg, mArg, see To TRACK. — (Mark out) vAhyare- KAm aNk (c. 10. aNkayati -yituM) or liK (c. 6. liKati, leKituM).
Trachea, s. SvAsa-prARa-mArgaH.
TRACHEA , s. SvAsamArgaH, SvAsapraSvAsamArgaH, prARamArgaH.
Track, v. t. anu-sf 1 P, anu-DAv 1 P, mArg 10; See Follow. s. mArgaH, padacihnaM paMkti f.; See Way. 2 cihnaM, aMkaH. [Track]less, a. niHsaMcAra, nirjana, pAdAspfzwa.
TRACK (v.): (1) vimArgayati (mfga, c. 10.): v. search;(2) anusarati (sf, c. 1.): v. To follow.
TRACK , s. padavI -viH f., mArgaH, paTaH, panTAH m., see ROAD, TRACE.
To TRACK , v. a. pAdAnusaraRaM kf, padAnusaraRaM kf, mArgAnusaraRaM kf, anupadaM yA (c. 2. yAti -tuM) or gam, anusf, see To PURSUE.
TRACKLESS: I Markless: expr. by circumlo. II Without any path.: niHsaYcAra (f. rA) and sim. comp.s.
TRACKLESS , a. pAdAspfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, pAdANkarahitaH &c., padavihInaH &c.
Tract, s. pra-, deSaH, BUBAgaH. 2 prabaMDaH, graMTaH, laGuleKaH-graMTaH.
TRACT: I Place, region: q. v.: BUBAgaH.II Treatise, book: q. v.: prabanDaH.
TRACT , s. deSaH, pradeSaH, see REGION, COUNTRY. — (Short treatise) leKaH, patrikA, alpaprabanDaH, svalpaprabanDaH.
TRACTABILITY , s. viDeyatA, vineyatA, vaSyatA, savinayatA.
Tractable, a. viDeya, vinIta; vaSya; See Docile.
TRACTABLE: viDeya (f. yA): v. Docile, sub- -missive.
TRACTABLE , a. viDeyaH -yA -yaM, vaSyaH &c., see DOCILE, MANAGEABLE.
Traction, s. karzaRaM, vahanaM.

Trade, s. vARijyaM, vaRikkarman n., vyApAraH, krayavikrayaH. 2 vyavasAyaH, vyavahAraH, vftti f., vyApAraH. v. i. vARijyaM kf 8 U, vyava-hf 1 P, paR 1 A, krayavikrayaM kf; oft. by (s.); ‘went out to t(rade)’ vARijyena gataH; ‘t(rad)ing by sea’ samudravyavahArI (S. 6). [Trad]er, s. vaRij m., vARijyakArin; See Merchant. Tradesman, s. paRya-vikrayin m.
TRADE (subs.): (1) vARijyam (rarely vaRijyA = commerce);(2) vyavahAraH (= business);(3) vyApAraH (=2);(4) vyavasAyaH (=2).
TRADE (v.): vARijyaM karoti, K. s. vi. 47.; one who t.s in paddy: DAnyavyavasAyin (f. nI); one who t. s in book: pustakavikrayin (f. RI): v. To sell.

TRADE , s. (Commerce) bARijyaM -jyA, baRijyaM, baRikkarmma n. (n), baRikkriyA, arTaprayogaH, krayavikrayaH, vyApAraH, nIvaraH, koSAtakI m. (n), see COMMERCE. — (Occupation of a man of the third class) vESyakriyA, vESyavfttiH f. — (Occupation) vyApAraH, vyavasAyaH, vyavahAraH.
To TRADE , v. n. bARijyaM kf, krayavikrayaM kf, vyApAraM kf, upakrI.
TRADER: (1) vARijyakArin (f. RI);(2) vikrayin (f. RI = seller: q. v.).
TRADER , s. baRik m. (j), bARijikaH &c. See MERCHANT.
TRADESMAN: paRyavikrayin (f. RI): v. Shop- -keeper.
TRADESMAN , s. pattanabaRik m. (j), nagarabaRik, see SHOP-KEEPER.

sanskrit.slp1: kumArasya punaH kutaH saMpradAya iti pfcCAmi
