details.body: Tradition, s. saMpradAyaH, AmnAyaH. 2 EtihyaM, lokakaTA, pAraMparIyakaTA, pAraMparyaM; ‘there runs a t(radition) to this effect’ iti EtihyaM. [Tradition]al, [Tradition]ary, a. paraMparAgata-prApta, paraMparIRa, kramA-gata-AyAta, sAMpradAyika-pOrARika- (kI f.); ‘t(raditional) knowledge’ saMpradAyaH, (kumArasya punaH kutaH saMpradAya iti pfcCAmi U. 6). [Tradition]ally, adv. saMpradAyataH, pAraMparyeRa.
TRADITION: handed down by t.: anekavfdDaparamparA- samAgata (f. tA), K.: v. Also rumour, his- -tory.

TRADITION , s. lokakaTA, itihAsaH, paramparAgatakaTA, paramparAgatavAkyaM, pAramparyyaM, paramparAgatAcAraH, pAramparyyopadeSaH, pAramparIyakaTA, EtihyaM, itiha ind., sampradAyaH, AmrAyaH, purARaM, pUrvvaM, DoraRiH f., pravAdaH, AKyAyikA, gurukramaH, oGaH.

TRADITIONAL , TRADITIONARY, a. paramparAgataH -tA -taM, paramparAyAtaH &c., paramparIRaH -RA -RaM, pAramparIyaH -yI -yaM, paramparAprAptaH -ptA -ptaM, Eti- hAsikaH -kI -kaM, pOrARikaH -kI -kaM, purARoktaH -ktA -ktaM, sAmpradAyikaH -kI -kaM, kramAgataH -tA -taM, kramAyAtaH &c., kramaprAptaH &c., oGaprAptaH &c., rUQaH -QA -QaM; ‘instruction,’ pAramparyyopadeSaH; ‘practice,’ vaMSAnucaritaM.
TRADITIONALLY , adv. pAramparyyeRa, paramparAkrameRa, sampradAyatas,
Traduce, v. t. Akzar c., aBiSaMs 1 P, apa-pari-vaw 1 A; See Calumniate. [Traduc]er, s. AkzArakaH, apavAdakaH.
TRADUCE: aBiSaMsati (SaMs, c. 1.): v. Calum- -niate.
TRADUCER: aBiSaMsaka (f. sikA): v. Calum- -niator.
TRADUCER , s. apavAdakaH, aBiSaMsI m. (n), see CALUMNIATOR.
TRAFFIC , s. vARijyaM, lokavyavahAraH, lokavAtrA, see COMMERCE.
To TRAFFIC , v. n. bARijyaM kf, paR. See To COMMERCE, TRADE.
TRAGEDIAN: *mahAnAwakakft (mfn.); lokanAwakakAra (f. rI); etc.
TRAGEDIAN , s. karuRarasABinayakuSalaH, karuRArasABinetA m. (tf).
Tragedy, s. SokaparyavasAyi nAwakaM. Tragic. Tragical, a. SokaparyavasAyin, duraMta. 2 karuRarasapraDAna.
TRAGEDY: *mahAnAwakam, lokanAwakam, etc.
TRAGEDY , s. duHKapariRAmakanAwakaM, karuRArasapraDAnanAwakaM.
TRAGI-COMEDY: *miSranAwakam.
TRAGIC, TRAGICAL: I Of a tragedy: expr. [Page718] by comp.II Fatal, mournful: q. v.: duranta (f. ntA).

TRAGIC , TRAGICAL, a. (Pertaining to tragedy) duHKapariRAmanAwaka- sambanDI &c., karuRArasapraDAnaH -nA -naM, karuRArasavizayakaH -kA -kaM. — (Ending tragically) duHKapariRAmakaH -kA -kaM, duzpariRAmI -minI &c., durantaH -ntA -ntaM.
Trail, s. gaMDaH. 2 padavI, pAdacihna, padaM. v. t. vi-A-kfz 1 P; See Drag. v. i. kfz pass.
TRAIL (subs.): I Foot-print: q. v.: padavI. II Scent left: ganDaH.
TRAIL (v.): Akarzati (kfz, c. 1.): v. To drag, draw.
To TRAIL , v. a. vikfz (c. 1. -karzati -krazwuM), Akfz, samAkfz, kfz.
To TRAIL , v. n. vikfz in pass. (-kfzyate), Akfz, kfz, kfzwaH -zwA -zwaM BU.
TRAIL , s. (Track) padaviH -vI f. — (Scent left) ganDaH.

Train, s. paraMparA, SreRI, mAlA; See Series. 2 parivAraH, paribarhaH, parijanaH. 3 (Of dress) pucCaM, vasanAMtaH. 4 paripAwI, anu-, kramaH; prabaMDaH; ‘t(rain) of reasoning’ UhakramaH, tarka-prabaMDaH; ‘t(rain) of a peacock’ barhaH, pucCaM. v. t. vi-nI 1 P, (animal also), aDi-i c. (aDyApayati); anu-, SAs 2 P, Sikz c.; dam c. (damayati). 2 paricayaM-aByAsaM-kf c.; ‘a t(rain)ed soldier’ kftaSastraparicayaH padAtI. [Train]ing, s. SikzA, vinayaH-yanaM; SikzaRaM, aByAsaH; ‘military t(raining)’ raRa-astra-SikzA, yudDAByAsaH.
TRAIN (subs.): I A series, succession: paramparA. II Retinue: q. v.: parivarhaH.III Railway: *lOhaSakawamAlA.IV Of dress: pucCaH (?). V. Of army: perh. parivarhaH.
TRAIN (v.): I Educate, instruct: q. v.: vinayati (nI, c. 1.).II To accustom, exercise: q. v.: paricayaM karoti, t. ed to arms: paricitaSastra (f. strA): v. Conversant.
To TRAIN , v. a. vinI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM), Sikz (c. 10. Sikzayati -yituM), anuSikz, SAs, anuSAs, anuSAsanaM kf, niyamanaM kf. See To DISCIPLINE.

TRAIN , s. (End of a robe) vasanAntaH, mAnavastrAntaH, vasanaBAraH. — (Retinue) parivAraH, parivarhaH, sAmagryaM, see RETINUE. — (Concate- nation) SreRI, prabanDaH, see SERIES, SUCCESSION; ‘train of fraud,’ kapawaprabanDaH; ‘of reasoning,’ tarkaprabanDaH, anumAnaprabanDaH. — (Regu- lar course) kramaH, anukramaH. — (Of gunpowder) AgneyacUrRaSreRI. — (Of a peacock) varhaH, varhaBAraH.
TRAINED , p. p. SikzitaH -tA -taM, vinItaH -tA -taM, anunItaH &c., kftA- ByAsaH -sA -saM, damitaH -tA -taM, dAntaH -ntA -ntaM. See DISCIPLINED, EDUCATED.
TRAINING (subs.): SikzA: v. Instruction, education.
TRAINING , s. SikzA, see EDUCATION; ‘of a horse,’ aSvaSikzA.
Trait, s. lakzaRaM, cihnaM.
TRAIT: lakzaRam: v. Feature, mark.
TRAIT , s. lakzaRaM; ‘bad trait,’ kulakzaRaM, durlakzaRaM; ‘good,’ sulakzaRaM.

Traitor, [Traitor]ous, s., a. viSvAsa-viSraMBa-GAtin, miTyApratijYa, Satru-dviw-sevin; ‘t(raitorous) to the king’ rAjApaTyakArin, rAjadrohin; ‘t(raitorous) to the country’ svadeSaSatruH-GAtakaH; ‘act the t(raitorous)’ druh 4 P.
TRAITOR, TRAITOROUS: (1) viSvAsaGAtaka (f. tikA);(2) viSvAsahan (mfn.);(3) viSvAsaGAtin (f. nI).

TRAITOR , s. (One guilty of treason) rAjadrohI m. (n), SatrusevI m., dviwsevI m., rAjaSatruH, deSadrohI m., BettA m. (ttf), BedakaH, upajApakaH. — (One who betrays his trust) viSvAsaGAtI m. (n), viSvAsa- GAtakaH, vaYcakaH, visaMvAdI m., miTyApratijYaH, viSramBaGAtI m.
TRAITOROUS , a. rAjApaTyakArI &c., rAjadrohI &c., see TREASONABLE.
TRAMMEL: I Subs.: banDaH: v. Fetter.II Verb: baDnAti (banD, c. 9.): v. To fetter, bind.
Tramp, v. i. caraRaM-pAdaM-nyas 4 P or kzip 6 P. s. pAdaSabdaH, caraRavikzepaH.
To TRAMP , v. n. caraRapAtaM kf, padanyAsaM kf, padavizwamBaM kf.

Trample, v. t. mfd 9 P, saM-ava-°, aBihan 2 P; (under foot) pAdatalena Ahan 2 U or A-samA-kram 1 U, 4 P or kzud 7 P; ‘t(rample) to dust’ cUrR 10; nizpiz 7 P. [Trampl]ed, a. saM-ava-mardita, pAdatalAhata, pAdAkrAMta; pAdakzuRRa. [Trampl]ing, s. mardanaM, pAdAGAtaH, pAdAkramaRaM, pramaTanaM.
TRAMPLE: mfdrAti (mfd, c. 9.): v. To crush, overwhelm.

To TRAMPLE , v. a. pAdAByAM mfd (c. 9. mfdnAti, mardituM) or sammfd or pramfd or upamfd or avamfd, pAdAGAtena mfd or kzud (c. 7. kzuRatti, kzottuM), mardanaM kf, upamardanaM kf, avamardanaM kf, pAdAByAm Akram or samAkram.

TRAMPLED , p. p. pAdAByAM marditaH -tA -taM or sammarditaH &c. or upama- rditaH &c. or avamarditaH &c., pAdAhataH -tA -taM, pAdamarditaH &c., pAdanyAsamarditaH &c., pAdakzuRRaH -RRA -RRaM, pramaTitaH -tA -taM.
TRAMPLING , s. mardanaM, upamardaH -rdanaM, avamardaH -rdanaM, sammardaH -rdanaM, pAdA- hatiH f., pAdAGAtaH, padapAtaH, caraRapAtaH, pAdAsPAlanaM, pAdADyAsaH, caraRAskandanaM, pramaTanaM.
Trance, s. samADiH, layaH, tanmayAvasTA, dehA-tItavftti f., ‘being in a t(rance)’ lInavftti, samADisTa.
TRANCE: perh. pramohaH: v. Also ecstasy.
TRANCE , s. dehAtItavfttiH f., mohAvasTA, samADiH m., tanmayAvasTA, mUrcCanA, AveSaH, mohaH, lokAntaracittavfttiH f.

Tranquil, a. pra-, SAMta, stimita, niScala, svasTa, akzubDa, SAMtAtman; See Calm. [Tranquil]lity, s. SamaH, SAMti f., pra-, upa-°, akzoBaH, nirvfti f., nirupaplavatvaM, DEryaM, anudvegaH, svAsTyaM, sTEryaM. [Tranquil]lize, v. t. sAM(SAM)tv 10, Sam c. (Samayati), pra-upa-°, A-samA-Svas c.; See Calm, Compose; ‘t(ranquilize) yourself’ samASva-sihi.
TRANQUIL: SAnta, pra- (f. ntA): v. Calm, quiet.
TRANQUIL , a. SAntaH -ntA -ntaM, praSAntaH &c., sTiraH -rA -raM, svasTaH -sTA -sTaM, SAntAtmA -tmA -tma (n), svasTacittaH -ttA -ttaM, akzubDaH -bDA -bDaM. See CALM.
To TRANQUILIZE , v. a. Sam (c. 10. Samayati -yituM), see To CALM, COMPOSE.
TRANQUILLITY: SAntiH, pra-H v. Calmness, peace.
TRANQUILLITY , s. SAntiH f., SamaH, SAntatA, nirvftiH f., sTiratA, akzu- bDatA, akzoBaH, svasTatA, svAsTyaM, nirupadravatA. See CALMNESS, COMPOSURE.
TRANQUILLIZE: sA(SA)ntvayati(sA[SA]ntv, c. 10.): v. To quiet, pacify.

Transact, v. t. saM-niH-pad c., sAD 5 P or c., vi-DA 3 U, kf 8 U, anu-zWA 1 P; nirvah c., pravft c., A-samA-car 1 P; (a business) paR 1 A, vyava-hf 1 P. [Transact]ion, s. karaRaM, anuzWAnaM, viDAnaM, nirvAhaH, AcaraRaM &c. 2 kAryaM, kftyaM, karman n., vyApAraH, vyavahAraH, paRAyA.
TRANSACT: (1) karotiH v. To do;(2) nizpA- dayatiH v. To accomplish.

To TRANSACT , v. a. nirvah (c. 10. -vAhayati -yidgu), vyavahf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), viDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM), praRI, sampraRI, pravft in caus. [Page809-b+ 51] Acar, samAcar, anuzWA, tIr (c. 10. tIrayati -yituM), pAr (c. 10. pArayati -yituM), paR (c. 10. paRayati -yituM), kf; ‘business,’ karmma- nirvAhaM kf.
TRANSACTED , p. p. nirvAhitaH -tA -taM, paRAyitaH -tA -taM, paRitaH -tA -taM, AcaritaH -tA -taM.
TRANSACTION: I The act:(1) karaRam;(2) anuzWAnam: v. Accomplishment, performance. II Act, affair: kAryam.

TRANSACTION , s. (The act of doing) nirvAhaH -haRaM, pravarttanaM, viDAnaM, AcaraRaM, praRayanaM, anuzWAnaM; ‘of business,’ karmmanirvAhaH. — (Affair) karmma n. (n), kAryyaM, vyApAraH, vyavahAraH, vfttAntaH, paRAyA.

Transcend, v. t. ati-i 2 P, ati-SI 2 A; atikram 1 U, 4 P; See Excel; ‘t(ranscend)s definition’ aparicCedya, paricCedAtIta; ‘t(ranscend)s description’ sakalavacanAnAmavizayaH (Mal. 1), varRanavizayAtikrAMtaH; See Pass. [Transcend]ent, [Transcend]ental, a. sarvAtirikta, sarvAtiSAyin, atyuttama. [Transcend]ently, adv. saviSezaM, paramaM, atyuttamaM.
TRANSCEND: atikrAmati (kram, c. 1.): v. To surpass.
TRANSCENDENT, -AL: (1) sarvAtiSAyin (f. nI); (2) sarvAtirikta (f. ktA), R. i. 14.; etc.
TRANSCENDENTAL , a. atyuttamaH -mA -maM. See SURPASSING, SUPERIOR.
TRANSCENDENTLY , adv. atyuttamaM, atyantaM, aDikaM, aByaDikaM, paramaM.
Transcribe, v. t. liK 6 P. [Transcrib]er, s. lipikAraH; leKakaH. Transcript, s. pratileKaH, prati-, lipi f.
TRANSCRIBE: liKati (liK, c. 6.: when sense clear): v. To copy.
TRANSCRIBER: lipikaraH: v. Copyist, writer.
TRANSCRIBER , s. lipikAraH, pratilipikArakaH, AdarSakArakaH.
TRANSCRIPT: perh. pratilipiH or pratileKaH.

Transfer, v. t. sTAnAMtaraM nI 1 P or gam c. 2 saM-kram c. (with loc. for ‘to’) saMcar c., saM-, f c. (arpayati), nikzip 6 P, aDyAruh c.; tanayasnehaM taruzu saMkramayya (Ka. 345), (putrasaMkrAMtalakzmIkEH U. 1). [Transfer]ence, s. sTAnAMtaraprApaRaM-nayanaM, sTAna-sTala-parivftti, f.. 2 saMkrAMti f., saMkramaRaM, saMcAraH, parahastasamarpaRaM.
TRANSFER (v.): I t. the case in another court: *vicArakAntare samarpayAmyarTam; t. red to another division: *viBAgAntaraM prezita (f. tA): v. To send, deliver, give.

To TRANSFER , v. a. (Make over, cause to pass) saMkram in caus. (-krAmayati -yituM), upasaMkram, saMcar in caus. (-cArayati -yituM), samf in caus. (-arpayati -yituM), aDyAruh in caus. (-ropayati -yituM), apavft (c. 10. -varttayati -yituM); ‘to another,’ parasmin or parasmE or parahaste samf in caus. or saMkram in caus. — (Convey from one place to another) sTAnAntarIkf, sTalAntarIkf.
TRANSFERABLE , a. saNkrAmaRIyaH -yA -yaM, saYcAraRIyaH &c., parasamarpaRIyaH &c.
TRANSFERRED , p. p. saNkrAmitaH -tA -taM, saNkrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, upasaNkrAntaH &c., saYcAritaH &c., parahastasamarpitaH &c., aDyastaH -stA -staM.
TRANSFIGURATION , s. rUpAntaragrahaRaM, mUrttyantaragrahaRaM, rUpaparivarttanaM.
To TRANSFIGURE , v. a. rUpAntarIkf, mUrttyantaraM kf, see To TRANSFORM.
TRANSFIGURED , p. p. rUpAntarIkftaH -tA -taM. See TRANSFORMED.
Transfix, v. t. vyaD 4 P, nirBid 7 P. 2 jaqIkf 8 U, kIl 10, niKan 1 P, kIliteva cAsminneva sTAne tanuH (Ka. 278) ‘as if t(ransfix)ed to this very spot’; ‘t(ransfix)ed through the belly’ nirBinnodara.
TRANSFIX: I Lit.: pravayati (ve, c. 1.), t. ed with dart: prAsaprota (f. tA), Vi.: v. Also to pierce.II Fig.: jaqIkarotiH v. To stupefy.

To TRANSFIX , v. a. vyaD (c. 4. viDyati, vyadDuM), prativyaD, Bid (c. 7. Binatti, BettuM), SUl (c. 1. SUlati -lituM), kIl (c. 10. kIlayati -yituM), niKan (c. 1. -Kanati -nituM), Cur (c. 6. Curati -rituM). See To PIERCE.
TRANSFIXED , p. p. vidDaH -dDA -dDaM, atividDaH &c., kIlitaH -tA -taM, CuritaH &c.; ‘through the belly,’ CuritodaraH -rA -raM.

Transform, v. t. pariRam c. (pariRamayati), rUpAMtaraM vi-DA 3 U, AkAraM-rUpaM-parivft c.; ‘to be t(ransform)ed’ pariRam 1 U, rUpAMtareRa pari-RatA &c. (V. 4). 2 viqaMb 10, vikf 8 U. [Transform]ation, s. rUpAMtarapariRAmaH, parivartaH, rUpAMtaraM, vikfti f., viqaMbanaM.
TRANSFORM: she will be t. ed into a plant: sA latABAve pariRatarUpA Bavizyati, Vi. iv.; as if t. ed: rUpAntareReva pariRata (f. tA), K.: v. To change, form.
To TRANSFORM , v. a. rUpaM parivft in caus., rUpaparivarttanaM kf, rUpA- ntarIkfM, viqamb (c. 10. -qambayati -yituM). See To METAMORPHOSE.
TRANSFORMATION: (1) rUpAntarapariRatiH;(2) parivartaH (= change).
TRANSFORMATION , s. rUpAntarIkaraRaM, rUpAntaraM, mUrttiparivarttanaM, viqambanaM, vyAkftiH f., pariRAmaH. See METAMORPHOSIS.
TRANSFORMED , p. p. vyAkftaH -tA -taM, viqambitaH &c. See META- MORPHOSED.
Transfuse, v. t. anyapAtre saMkram c. or niviS c. [Transfus]ion, s. saMkrAmaRaM.
TRANSFUSE: (1) saMkrAmaRam;(2) saMkrAntiH.
To TRANSFUSE , v. a. ekapAtrAByantarAt srAvayitvA anyapAtre niviS (c. 10. -veSayati -yituM) or nizic, pAtrAntarIkf. See To TRANSFER.
TRANSFUSION , s. saNkrAmaRaM, saNkrAntiH f., saYcAraRaM, pAtrAntarIkaraRaM.

Transgress, v. t. vi-, atikram 1 U, 4 P, ati-i 2 P, ud-, laMG 1 A, 10, BaMj 7 P; vyaBi-ati-car 1 P, ativft 1 A, lup 6 P or c. v. i. apa-, rAD 4 P (with loc. of person); See Offend. [Transgress]ion, s. atikramaH, ullaMGanaM, vyatikramaH, atyAcAraH, atyayaH, BaMgaH, lopaH, atipAtaH. 2 aparADaH, dozaH, pApaM. [Transgress]or, s. atikrAmin, atyAcArI, apa-rADI.
TRANSGRESS (v.): I Trans.: atikrAmati, vi- (kram, c. 1.): v. To break, violate.II Intrans.: aparADyati (rAD, c. 4.): v. To offend, sin.

To TRANSGRESS , v. a. laNG (c. 10. laNGayati -yituM), ullaNG, atikram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM), samatikram, vyatikram, aByatikram, aticar (c. 1. -carati -rituM), vyaBicar, ullaNGanaM kf, laNGanaM kf, atikramaRaM kf, vyatikramaM kf, ativft. See To SURPASS.
To TRANSGRESS , v. n. aparAD, aparADaM kf. See To OFFEND, v. n.
TRANSGRESSED , p. p. ullaNGitaH -tA -taM, laNGitaH &c., vilaNGitaH &c., atikrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, vyatikrAntaH &c., samatikrAntaH &c., utkrAntaH &c., atItaH &c.
TRANSGRESSION: I The act: atikramaH, vi-: v. Violation.II Offence, fault: q. v.: aparADaH.

TRANSGRESSION , s. (The act of transgressing) NGanaM, ullaNGanaM, vilaNGanaM, atikramaH -maRaM, vyatikramaH, samatikramaH, utkramaH -maRaM, ati- pAtaH, atyAcAraH, upAtyaya atyayaH, BaNgaH, lopaH -pajaM, amaryyAdA. — [Page810-a+ 51] (Offence) aparADaH, pApaM, pAtakaM, see OFFENCE.
TRANSGRESSOR: I Lit.: expr. by verb or comp.: v. Violator.II Offender, sinner: q. v.: aparADin (f. nI).
TRANSGRESSOR , s. (One who goes beyond) atikrAmakaH, atikramI m. (n), ullaNGI m., atyAcArI m. — (Sinner) aparADI m., see OFFENDER.
Tranship, v. t. vAhana-yAna-aMtaraM nI 1 P.
Transient, a. caMcala, lola, kzaRaBaMgura, acirasTAyin, asTAyin, capala, vinaSvara, anitya, kzaRika, asAra, aSASvata (tI f.), kzaRaviDvaMsin. [Transient]ness, s. anityatA, asTA-yitvaM.

TRANSIENT: I Fleeting, passing:(1) acira- sTAyin (f. nI);(2) caYcalaH (lA, laM), wealth is t.: caYcalaM vasu, Ki. xiii. 53.;(3) capalaH (lA, laM = unsteady), life is very t.: jIvana- matiSayacapalam, J.;(4) anitya (f. tyA = not eternal).II Momentary, hasty: kzaRika (f. kA).

TRANSIENT , a. acirasTAyI -yinI &c., asTAyI &c., kzaRikaH -kA -kaM, kzaRaviDvaMsI &c., BaNguraH -rA -raM, kzaRaBaNguraH &c., caYcalaH -lA -laM, anityaH -tyA -tyaM, aciravinaSvaraH -rA -raM, naSvaraH &c., aSASvataH -tI -taM. See MOMENTARY, TEMPORARY.
TRANSIENTNESS , s. acirasTAyitvaM, asTAyitA, anityatA.

Transit, s. krAMti f., saMkramaH. [Transit]ion, s. saMkrAMti f., parivartaH, vikAraH; (state) sTityaMtaraM, avasTAMtaraM. [Transit]ive, a. sakarmaka. [Transit]ory, a. kzaRaBaMgura, asAra; See Transient.
TRANSIT: krAntiH (?), t. of Venus *SukrakrAntiH.
TRANSIT ; s. saNkramaH -maRaM, saNkrAntiH f., saNkrAmaH, krAntiH f., atikramaH -maRaM, gatiH f.; ‘of a star,’ tArAsaNkramaH.
TRANSITION , s. saNkramaH -maRaM, saNkrAntiH f., vikAraH, saYcAraH, avasTAntaraM, sTityantaraM, aBilamBanaM, sTAnAntaraM.
TRANSITIVE: sakarmakaH, “nanu sarvezAM sakarmakatAyAnti” Kaṇāda.
TRANSITIVE , a. (Verb) sakarmmakaH, sakarmmakriyA; ‘transitive voice,’ parasmEpadaM.
TRANSITORINESS: (1) kzaRaBaNguratA;(2) acira- sTAyitA etc. (= transientness).
TRANSITORY: kzaRaBaNguraH (rA, raM): v. Transient.
TRANSITORY , a. asTAyI &c., jagan -gatI -gat. See TRANSIENT.

Translate, v. t. BAzAMtareRa vi-pariRam c. or parivft c.; ‘boys should t(ranslate) Sanskrit sentences into English’ bAlakAH saMskf-tavAkyAni AMglaBAzayA vipariRamayeyuH. 2 Transform, q. v. 3 (To the skies) (saSarIraM) lokAMtaraM nI 1 P or prAp c. or gam c., ‘t(ranslat)ed to the skies’ saSarIramuktaH. [Translat]ion, s. vipariRAmaH, vipariRamanaM, BAzAMtaraM, anuvAdaH. 2 lokAMtaranayanaM, svargAropaRaM, saSarIramukti f. [Translat]or, s. BAzAMtarakft m.
TRANSLATE: I Lit.:(1) karoti (=render); (2) BAzAntarIkaroti (?).II To transform: q. v.III By death: lokAntaraM nayati (nI, c. 1.). t. d: lokAntaragata (f. tA); etc.

To TRANSLATE , v. a. (Remove), see To REMOVE, TRANSFER; ‘to heaven,’ saSarIraM svargam Aruh in caus. — (Into another lan- guage) BAzAntarIkf, avatF (c. 1. -tarati -rituM -rItuM), avataraRaM kf, vivf, BAzAntare nirUp (c. 10. -rUpayati -yituM).

TRANSLATED , p. p. (Removed), see REMOVED; ‘to heaven,’ saSarIrasvargAropitaH -tA -taM, saSarIramuktaH -ktA -ktaM. — (Into another language) BAzAntarIkftaH -tA -taM, avatIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, vivftaH -tA -taM, BAzAntare nirUpitaH -tA -taM; ‘Prākṛt translated into Sanskrit,’ prAkftaH saMskfte nirUpitaH.
TRANSLATION: I The act: t. into English: iMlaRqIyaBAzAyAM karaRam.II What is translated: *BAzAntarIkfta (f. tAH (?).III Removal, transformation: q. v.

TRANSLATION , s. (Removal), see REMOVAL; ‘to heaven,’ saSarI- rasvargAropaRaM, saSarIramuktiH f. — (Into another language) BAzAntaraM, BAzAntarIkaraRaM, avataraRaM, avatAraH, vivaraRaM, BAzAntare nirUpaRaM; ‘loose translation,’ CAyAnuharaRaM.
TRANSLATOR: *BAzAntarIkAraka (f. rikA); better by verb.
TRANSLATOR , s. BAzAntarakArI m. (n), avataraRakft, vyAKyAtA m. (ta), arTavyAKyAtA m., arTanirUpakaH. See INTERPRETER.
TRANSLUCENT: svacCa (f. cCA): v. Clear, lucid.
Transmigrate, v. i. punarjanma prAp 5 P, dehAMtaraM gam 1 P. [Transmigrat]ion, s. punarjanman n., punarjananaM, dehAMtaraprApti. f. -gamanaM, yonyaMtaraM.
To TRANSMIGRATE , v. n. dehAntaraM gam (c. 1. gacCati, gantuM), SarIrAntaraM gam, janmAntaraM or punarjanma prAp, yoniBramaRaM kf.

TRANSMIGRATION , s. dehAntaraprAptiH f., dehAntaragatiH f. -gamanaM, SarIrAnta- raprAptiH f., punarjanma n. (n), janmAntaraM, janmamaraRaM, yoniBramaRaM, punarA- vfttiH f., gatiH f.; ‘exemption from it,’ apunarAvfttiH f.
TRANSMISSION , TRANSMITTAL, s. saYcAraH -raRaM, saNkrAmaRaM, saNkrAntiH f., saYcAlanaM, preraRaM, prApaRaM, aBivAhyaM.
Transmit, v. t. See Send, Remit. Transmission, s. prApaRaM, vAhanaM, prezaRaM, saMcAraRaM.
TRANSMIT: I To send: q. v.: prerayati (Ir, c. 10.). To be t. ted: (= to pass): q. v.: gacCati (gam, c. 1.).II To suffer, to pass through: iron t. s electricity: *lOhena vidyunnizpatati.
To TRANSMIT , v. a. saMcar in caus. (-cArayati -yituM), saMkram in caus. (-krAmayati -yituM), upasaMkram, prer (c. 10. prerayati -yituM), prAp in caus.
TRANSMITTED , p. p. saYcAritaH -tA -taM, saNkrAmitaH &c., preritaH &c.
TRANSMUTATION: pariRatiH: v. Change.
TRANSMUTATION , s. pariRAmaH, pariRAmAntaraM, dravyAntaraM.
TRANSMUTE: parivartayati (c. of vft): v. To change.
To TRANSMUTE , v. a. dravyAntarIkf, pariRAmaBedaM kf, jAtyantaraM kf.
TRANSPARENCY: I Lit.: svacCatA: v. Clear- -ness.II A picture: *svacCAleKyam or -citram.
TRANSPARENCY , s. svacCatA -tvaM, acCatA, prasannatA, prasattiH f., nirmalatA, prakASaBedyatA, kiraRaBedyatA, prakASAroDakatA.
Transparent, a. SudDa, svacCa, prasanna, viSada, nir-vi-a-mala, sPawikapraBa. 2 prakASa-kiraRa-Bedya, pAradarSin. Transparency, s. svacCatA, prasAdaH, nErmalyaM, &c.
TRANSPARENT: acCa (f. cCA), su-: v. Clear.

TRANSPARENT , a. (Clear) svacCaH -cCA -cCaM, acCaH &c., prasannaH -nnA -nnaM, nirmalaH -lA -laM, amalaH &c., sPawikapraBaH -BA -BaM. — (Transmitting light, not opake) prakASaBedyaH -dyA -dyaM, kiraRaBedyaH &c., prakASA- roDakaH -kA -kaM, prakASApratibanDakaH &c., dfzwyaroDakaH &c., pAradarSakaH &c., maDyasTaH -sTA -sTaM.
Transpire, v. i. prakASatAM gam 1 P, pracalI-prakASI-BU 1 P, (kaTaM prakASatAM gatoyamarTaH pOrezu Mu. 1), prasidDIBU, niH-pra-sf 1 P.
TRANSPIRE: I To become public: q. v.: prakASImavati.II To come out: niHsarati (sf, c. 1.).
To TRANSPIRE , v. n. prasidDaH -dDA -dDaM BU, prasidDIBU prakASaH -SA -SaM BU, prakASIBU, pracalIBU, lokaviditaH -tA -taM BU.
Transplant, v. t. sTAnAMtare ruh c.
TRANSPLANT: sTAnAntare ropayati (c. of ruh): v. To plant.
To TRANSPLANT , v. a. sTAnAntare ruh in caus. (ropayati -yituM) or ropaRaM kf, unmUlya sTAnAntare ruh in caus., unmUl (c. 10. -mUla- yati -yituM).
TRANSPLANTED , p. p. sTAnAntare ropitaH -tA -taM, unmUlitaH -tA -taM.

Transport, v. t. nI-vah 1 P; tF c. 2 dvIpAM-tare nirvas c. or vivas c., svadeSAt dUrIkf 8 U. 2 atyaMtaM pramud c.; ‘Delight’ excessively, q. v.; ‘t(ransport)ed with joy’ harzanirBara, AnaMdasya parAM kowiM gata. s. nayanaM, vAhanaM. 2 pravahaRaM. 3 harzonmAdaH, harza-nirBaraH; harzAveSaH.
TRANSPORT: I Carry, convey: q. v.: nayati (nI, c. 1.).II To banish: dvIpAntaraM nayati. III To delight: q. v.
TRANSPORT (subs.): I Conveyance:(1) nayanam;(2) better by verb.II A ship: pravahaRam.III Rapture, ecstacy: q. v.: harza- nirBaraH.IV Of passion: kroDAveSaH and sim. comp. s.

To TRANSPORT , v. a. (Convey, carry) tF (c. 10. tArayAte -yituM), santF, vah, Avah, saMvah, sTAnAntarIkf, AnI, see To CONVEY. — (As a criminal) vivas (c. 10. -vAsayati -yituM), pravas, nirvas, pravraj (c. 10. -vrAjayati -yituM), deSAntarIkf, sAgarapAre dUrIkf, svadeSAd dUrIkf. — (Ravish), see the word.
TRANSPORT , s. (Conveyance) tAraRaM, santAraRaM, vAhanaM, AnayanaM. — (Of passion) kroDAveSaH, kopAveSaH. — (Rapture), see RAPTURE.
TRANSPORTATION: I Conveyance: vAhanam. II Banishment: dvIpAntaravivAsanam and sim. comp. s.
TRANSPORTATION , s. vivAsaH -sanaM, pravAsaH -sanaM, nirvAsanaM, vivAsakaraRaM, pravrAjanaM, sAgarapAre dUrIkaraRaM, santAraRaM, santArakatvaM.
TRANSPORTED , p. p. (Conveyed) santAritaH -tA -taM, tAritaH &c., AnItaH &c. — (Exiled) vivAsitaH &c. — (Enraptured), see the word.
Transpose, v. t. viparyas 4 U, sTAnaM pari-vft c., vini-me 1 A; See Exchange. [Transpos]ition, s. (sTAna-)vyatyayaH, vyatyAsaH, vinimayaH, viparyAsaH, parivftti f.
TRANSPOSE: vinimayaH (me, c. 1.): v. To interchange.
To TRANSPOSE , v. a. sTAnaparivarttanaM kf, sTAnavinimayaM kf, sTAnaviparyyayaM kf, sTAnaM parivft (c. 10. -varttayati -yituM), viparyas.
TRANSPOSED , p. p. parivarttitaH -tA -taM, viparyastaH &c., vyatyastaH &c.
TRANSPOSITION: (1) vinimayaH (= interchange); (2) vyatyayaH;(3) vyatyAsaH.
TRANSPOSITION , s. sTAnaparivarttanaM, sTAnavinimayaH, sTAnaviparyyayaH, vyatyAsaH, vyatyayaH, viparyyayaH, viparyyAsaH. — (In arithmetic) tulyaSadDiH f.
Transverse, a. vyatyasta, tiryak; ‘with legs t(ransverse)’ vyatyastapAda a. [Transverse]ly, adv. vyatyA-sena, tiryak, vyatyastaM.
TRANSVERSE: vyatyasta (f. stA): v. Also inverse.
TRANSVERSE , a. tiryyaN -ScI -ryyak (Yc), vyatyastaH -stA -staM, viparItaH &c.
TRANSVERSELY: (1) vyatyAsena (?);(2) tiryak (= obliquely).
TRANSVERSELY , adv. tiryyak, vyatyastaM, koRAkoRi, viparItaM.
Trap, s. unmATaH, kUwayaMtraM, kUwaM; ‘t(rap)-door’ kUwadvAraM, CannamArgaH. v. t. kUwe nikzip 6 P. 2 BUz or maMq 10.
TRAP (subs.): kUwam: v. Snare.
TRAP , s. unmATaH, kUwayantraM, kUwaH, pASaH, vAgurA, jAlaM, paYjarAKewaH, nAhaH, pAtilI. See SNARE.
TRAP-DOOR: (1) kUwAdvAraM (?);(2) pakzmadvAram (= side-door).
Trapezium, s. atulyalaMbakaH.
TRAPEZIUM: atulyalambakaM kzetram, Li. 160.; *vizama- caturBujaH.
TRAPEZIUM , s. vizamacaturasraM, vizamacaturBujaH, vizamacatuzkoRaH.
Trapezoid, s. samalaMbakaH.
TRAPEZOID: samalambaM kzetram, Li. and sim. comp. s.
Trappings, s. sajjA, BUzA, parikarman a. paricCadaH; ‘t(rappings) of an elephant’ parizwomaH, AdAnaM; See Housings.
TRAPPINGS: (1) sajjA (= equipment);(2) BUzA (= ornament).
TRAPPINGS , s. pl. paricCadaH, BUzaRaM, parikarmma n., see FINERY. — (Of a horse or elephant) paristomaH, varRaH, AdAnaM, AstaraH -raRaM, prave- RiH -RI f., kuTaH.
Trash, a. asAra, nirarTaka, niHsAra. s. asAra-nirarTaka-dravyaM.
TRASH (subs.): expr. by adj.: asAra (f. rA), tucCa (f. cCA) or nirarTaka (f. kA).
TRASH , s. asAradravyaM, tucCadravyaM, kutsitadravyaM. See RUBBISH.

Travel, v. i. pari-Bram 1, 4 P, pari-, aw 1 P. vicar 1 P; See Journey. [Travel]ling, s. paryawanaM, pari-, BramaRaM, vicaraRaM, yAtrA, pravAsaH, aDvagamanaM. [Travel]ler, s. pAMTaH, paTikaH, aDvagaH, aDvanInaH, aDvanyaH, yAtrikaH, pAdavikaH, sAraRikaH.
TRAVEL, TRAVELLING: (1) pariBramaRam;(2) paryawanam;(3) vicaraRam.

TRAVEL: (1) BrAmyati or Bramati (Bram, c. 4. and 1.), I have t. led through many countries: BrAnto deSamanekam, J.;(2) awati, pari- (aw, c. 1.), t. the holy places: tIrTARi paryawasva, Mah.;(3) vicarati (to move about), he t. ed over this world: vyacaratsa mahImimAM, Mah. iii. 135. 50.; (4) caMkramyate (from kram: rare), Mah iii. 136. 1.: v. Also to go.
To TRAVEL , v. n. vraj, pravraj, deSaBramaRaM kf, deSaparyawanaM kf, deSAwanaM kf, aDvanA gam, yAtrAM kf, car, vicar. See To JOURNEY.

TRAVEL , TRAVELING, s. aDvagamanaM, mArgagamanaM, deSaBramaRaM, BramaRaM, pariBramaRaM, paryawanaM, deSaparyawanaM, awanaM, yAtrA, saMyAtrA, vrajyA, awAwyA, mArgakramaRaM, pravAsaH; ‘to return from travel,’ pravAsAd Agam; ‘traveling- carriage,’ pAriyAnikaH; ‘companion,’ sahacaraH.

TRAVELLER: (1) paTikaH (= wayfarer), became t. s in the forest by the bank of the Bhāgīrathī:. BAgIraTItawavane paTikAvaBUtAm, C. r. ii. 53.;(2) pAnTaH (= 1);(3) pariBramaRakArin (f. RI) and sim. comp. s (rare).

TRAVELLER , s. paTikaH, pAnTaH, aDvagaH -gAmI m. (n), aDvanyaH, aDva- nInaH, yAtrikaH, pAdavikaH, sAraRikaH, mArgasTaH, paTilaH, gantuH m., gamaTaH, yAyI m. (n), deSikaH, itvaraH, proTaH, deSikaH, aDvani vartta- mAnaH, paradeSasevI m.; ‘a great traveller,’ bahudeSadarSI m.
Traverse, v. t. Akram 1 U, 4 P, tF 1 P, saM-ati-ut-°, pAraM gam 1 P.
TRAVERSE: I To cross: q. v.: tarati (tF, c. 1.).II To travel: q. v.
To TRAVERSE , v. a. tF (c. 1. tarati -rituM -rItuM), atitF, santF, atikram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM), parikram, pAraM gam (c. 1. gacCati, gantuM), or i.
TRAVERSED , p. p. atikrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, tIrRaH &c., pAragataH &c., pAramitaH &c.
TRAVESTY , s. hAsyajanakaviqambanaM, hAsyarasapraDAnAnukaraRakAvyaM, hAsyajana- kAnukaraRakavitA, AkAragopanaM.
Tray, s. BAjanaM, ADAraH, pAtraM.
TRAY: (1) BAjanam (?);(2) ADAraH (?).
TRAY , s. pAtraM, BAjanaM, SarAvaH, droRiH -RI f., ADAraH.
TREACHEROUS: (1) viSvAsahantf (f. ntrI), and t. men: viSvAsahantA ca naraH, M. p. 15. 7.;(2) viSvAsaGAtin (f. nI), I am not t. Rākṣasa: nAhaM viSramBaGAtI rAkzasaH, Mu. v.; and sim. comp. s.
TREACHEROUS , a. viSvAsaGAtI &c., miTyApratijYaH -jYA -jYaM, visaMvAdI &c., asatyasanDaH -nDA -nDaM, aviSvAsyaH &c., see PERFIDIOUS, FAITHLESS.
TREACHEROUSLY: (1) nikftyA (= wickedly), M.p. 15. 41.;(2) SAWyena (= deceitfully: q. v.).
TREACHEROUSNESS, TREACHERY: (1) viSvAsa- BaNgaH;(2) viSramBaGAtaH; etc.

Treachery, s. viSvAsaBaMgaH-GAtaH, viSraMBaBaMgaH, asatyasaMDatA, pratijYA-samaya-BaMgaH; See Perfidy. [Treacher]ous, a. viSvAsaGAtin, avi-SvAsya, asatyasaMDa. 2 miTyAvaBAsa, asAra, mAyAbahula. [Treacher]ously, adv. viSvAsaGAtena, SAWyena. [Treacher]ousness, s. See (s.).
TREACHERY , s. viSvAsaGAtaH, viSvAsaBaNgaH, visaMvAdaH, pratijYABaNgaH, upa- jApaH, upajapaH, DUrttatA, aBimaraH. See PERFIDY.
Treacle, s. guqaH; See Molasses.
TREACLE: (1) guqaH (= molasses);(2) guqocCizwam (the refuse).
TREACLE , s. ikzusAraH, ikzurasakvATaH, SarkarAkzAraH. See MOLASSES.

Tread, v. kzud 7 P, A-samA-kram 1 U, 4 P. pAdAByAM pIq 10 or Akram or mfd 9 P; ‘from the trodden path’ kzuRRAdvartmanaH, (kzudrajanakzuRRa eza mArgaH Ka. 146); ‘trod one of them to death’ tezAmekatamaH pAdAkrAMto'mriyata, ekaM pAdatalena avAmfndAta; ‘t(read) in the footsteps of’ padaM anuvi-DA 3 U, padavIM pratipad 4 A, (padavIM taruvalka-vAsasAM prapedire R. viii. 11). 2 kram, padaM-caraRaM-vinyas 4 P or f c. (arpayati). s. caraRapAtaH, pAdanyAsaH-vikzepaH, vikramaH.

TREAD (v.): kzuRatti (kzud, c. 7.), momentarily trodden by the fādava's forces: kzuRRaH kzaRaM yadubalEH, Si. v. 11.; were trodden upon by chariots: cukzudire raTOGEH, Si. iii. 27.; from the trodden path: kzuRRAdvartmanaH, R. i. 17.: v. Also to press, put.
TREAD: (1) pAdanyAsaH;(2) caraRapAtaH; etc.
To TREAD , v. n. caraRapAtaM kf, padapAtaM kf, pAdapAtaM kf, padanyAsaM kf, pAdA- rpaRaM kf, padavizwamBaM kf, kram (c. 1. krAmati, kramate -mituM).

To TREAD , v. a. Akram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM), samAkram, pAdAByAma Akram or pIi, padanyAsaM kf, pAdanyAsaM kf, pAdArpaRaM kf; ‘to tread on one's steps,’ padAkramaRaM kf; ‘one who does so,’ padAkrAntaH. — (Crush with the feet) pAdAByAM mfd or avamfd, see To TRAM- PLE, STAMP, STEP.
TREAD , s. padanyAsaH, pAdanyAsaH, padapAtaH, pAdapAtaH, caraRapAtaH, kramaH, vikramaH, pAdADyAsaH, pAdAGAtaH. See STEP, PACE.
Treason, s. rAjadrohaH, rAjABidrohaH-apakAraH, rAjApaTyakAritvaM. [Treason]able, [Treason]ous, a. rAjadro-hin, rAjApaTyakArin.
TREASON: (1) rAjadrohaH;(2) rAjABidrohaH, and sim. comp. s.
TREASON , s. rAjadrohaH, rAjABidrohaH, rAjaSarIrABidrohaH, rAjApakAraH, rAjApaTyakAritvaM, rAjaviroDaH.
TREASONABLE, TREASONOUS: (1) by comp. s.; (2) rAjadrohin (f. RI); etc.
TREASONABLE , a. rAjadrohI -hiRI -hi (n), rAjABidrohI &c., rAjA- pakArI &c., rAjadrohasambanDI &c., rAjaviroDI &c.

Treasure, s. koSaH-zaH, niDiH, niDAnaM, dravya-saMcayaH-rASiH-saMgrahaH. 2 vittaM, DanaM, BAMqaM, draviRaM; See Wealth. v. t. saM-ci 5 U, rASIkf 8 U, ni-upa-DA 3 U; See Store; ‘t(reasure) in the heart’ hfdi upa-ni-DA, avaDf 10, citte kf. [Treasur]er, s. koSADyakzaH-aDISaH, kozagfhe niyuktaH, arTADikArin m., DanA-DyakzaH, kanakADyakzaH, BOrikaH (‘gold t(reasurer)’); rUpyADyakzaH, nEzkikaH (‘silver t(reasurer)’). [Treasur]y, s. kozAgAraM, koSaH-zaH, BAMqAgAraM, koSagfhaM.
TREASURE (v.): saMcinoti (ci, c. 5.): v. To store.

TREASURE (subs.): I Lit.:(1) koSaH(zaH), t. is the life of those who possess it: kozaH kozavatAM prARaH, H. ii. 92.;(2) Danam (= money; riches).II Fig.:(1) ratnam;(2) Danam;(3) BARqam, t. of a son: putraBARqam, Vi. B. r.

TREASURE , s. (Store of valuables) niDiH m., niDAnaM, kozaH. — (Accumulation of money, &c.) DanasaYcayaH, dravyasaYcayaH, vittani- cayaH, DanarASiH m., DanasaNgrahaH, saYcitaDanaM. — (Money, &c.) DanaM, vittaM, vasu n. — (A treasure) niDiH m., kulABiH m. — (Divine treasure) niDiH m., sevaDiH m., see under KUVERA.
To TREASURE , v. a. niDiM kf, niDA, saMci, kozIkf. See To HOARD.
TREASURE-TROVE: (1) niDiH, like a poor man getting t.: niDiM labDveva nirDanaH, S. p.;(2) niKAtaM Danam and sim. comp. s.
TREASURED , p. p. saYcitaH -tA -taM, kozIkftaH &c., kozaBUtaH -tA -taM.
TREASURER: (1) kozADyakzaH;(2) koSADISaH, Vi. vi. 1.; and sim. comp. s.

TREASURER , s. kozADyakzaH, koSADyakzaH, koSADISaH, koSanAyakaH, DanA- DikArI m. (n), BARqAgArADyakzaH, DanADyakzaH, arTADikArI m., kana- kADyakzaH, kozWapAlaH, gaYjADikArI m., gaYjADipaH, DanADipaH, BARqA- gArI m., BOrikaH.
TREASURERSHIP: (1) koSADyakzatA and sim. comp. s;(2) arTADikAraH, H. ii.
TREASURERSHIP , s. kozADikAraH, arTADikAraH, gaYjADikAritvaM.

TREASURY: (1) koSaH(zaH): should send the second half to the t.: dvitIyamarDaM koSe niveSayet, V. s.; (2) koSagfham and sim. comp. s, R. v. 29.; (3) mARqAgAram (= store-house), Y. i. 320.; (4) BARqAram (= 3), employees in t.: BARqArikAH, M.n. on R. v. 29.
TREASURY , s. kozaH, koSaH, DanAgAraM, BARqAgAraM, DanaSAlA, DanagfhaM, kozWaH -zWakaM, gaYjaH -YjaM, arTasaMsTAnaM, niDiH m.

Treat, v. t. Ex. by ‘Act’ (towards) q. v.; putre mitravadAcaret ‘should t(reat) a son like a friend’; ‘t(reat) your rivals as dear friends’ kuru priyasaKIvfttiM sapatnI-jane (S. 4), ‘t(reat) with honour’ pUj 10, puraskf 8 U, satkf, sev 1 A; See Honour; ‘t(reat) hospitably’ AtiTyaM kf, atiTisatkAraM kf. 2 (A subject) nirUp 10, vicar c., varR 10, pra-stu 2 U; ‘t(reat) at length’ prapaMcayati (D.). 3 upa-upA-car 1 P, kit desid. (cikitsati-te). 4 saMtfp c.; ‘gave a good t(reat)’ BojanaviSezEH saMtarpa-yAcakAra; ‘t(reat) with’ saM-DA 3 U. s. BojanaviSezaH, uttamAnnatarpaRaM. [Treat]ment, s. AcaraRaM, vyavahAraH, vftti f., AcAraH, nayaH; ‘ill-t(reatment)’ apakAraH, apakriyA. 2 cikitsA, upacAraH, upakramaH. 3 varRanaM-nA, nirU-paRaM, vivecanaM, vicAraRA. [Treat]y, s. saMDiH, saMDAnaM. 2 saMDipatraM, niyama-samaya-patraM.

TREAT (v. t.): I To behave, act: q. v.: Acarati, sam- (car, c. 1.), should t. (grown up) sons like friends: putraM mitravadAcaret, J. Ph.: to t. with respect: v. To respect; to t. with contumely: v. To despise.II To describe: q. v.: varRayati (varR, c. 10.).III To satiate: q. v.: tarpayati, saM- (c. of tfp).IV Medically: (1) cikitsati (kit, c. 1.), Sr.;(2) upa-carati, upA-, (car, c. 1.), should t. him with febri- fuges: taM jvaraGnEH samupAcaret, Sr.;(3) upakrAmati (kram, c. 1.) (rare), having t. ed me with gesti- culations, charms, prayers, meditations etc.: mAM mudrAtantramantraDyAnAdiBirupakramya, D. ii. T. with: i. e. negotiate: saM-daDAti or -Datte (DA, c. 3.).
TREAT (subs.): to give a grand or rich t. to: BojanaviSezEH santarpayati.

To TREAT , v. a. (Act or behave towards) Acar (c. 1. -carati -rituM), samAcar, vyavahf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), sev (c. 1. sevate -vituM), viDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM), praRI (c. 1. -Rayati -RetuM), vinI; ‘one should treat one's son like a friend,’ putraM mitravad Acaret; ‘to treat ill,’ apakf, kuvyavahAraM kf; ‘to treat with respect,’ pUj, satkf, see To HONOUR; ‘with hospitality,’ satkf, satkAraM kf, AtiTyaM kf. — (Give food, &c.) uttamAnnena tfp (c. 10. tarpayati -yituM) or santfp. — (A disease) upacAraM kf, prayogaM kf, cikitsAM kf.

To TREAT , v. n. (Treat of any subject) vizayaprasaNgaM kf, prasaktiM kf, prastAvaM kf, prastutaM -tAM kf, maT (c. 1. maTati -TituM), maTanaM kf, vicar (c. 10. -cArayati -yituM), nirUp (c. 10. -rUpayati -yituM); ‘to treat at length,’ prapaYcanaM kf. — (Negotiate) paR, see the word.
TREAT , s. uttamAnnatarpaRaM, paramAnnaBojanaM, see FEAST, ENTERTAINMENT.

TREATED , p. p. AcaritaH -tA -taM, vyavahftaH &c., vyavahAritaH &c., sevitaH &c.; ‘ill-treated,’ apakftaH &c., kuvyavahAritaH -tA -taM; ‘well- treated,’ satkftaH -tA -taM, suvyavahAritaH &c., sevitaH &c., sevyamAnaH -nA -naM. — (Treated of) prastutaH -tA -taM, vicAritaH -tA -taM, maTitaH &c., nirUpitaH &c.; ‘at length,’ prapaYcitaH -tA -taM.
Treatise, s. ni-pra-baMDaH, leKaH.
TREATISE: (1) prabanDaH;(2) granTaH (= book).
TREATISE , s. nibanDaH, prabanDaH, granTaH, leKaH, SAstraM, pustakaM.
TREATMENT: I Behaviour, conduct:(1) AcaraRam;(2) vyavahAraH;(3) vfttiH.II Medical t.;(1) cikitsA;(2) upacAraH;(3) upakramaH (rare).III Description: q. v.: varRanA.
TREATMENT , s. praRayanaM, praRItiH f., nayaH, AcaraRaM, prayogaH, prayuktiH f., upAyaprayogaH; ‘of disease,’ upacAraH, cikitsA.
TREATY: I Negotiation: sanDAnam or sanDiH.II Agreement, condition: patram, t. of peace: sanDipatram; t. of marriage: vivAhapatram.
TREATY , s. niyamaH, samayaH, saMvid f. See COMPACT, LEAGUE.
Treble, a. triguRa, triviDa. s. (In music) tAraH; uccasvanaH. v. t. triguRIkf 8 U. Trebly, adv. triguRaM, triDA, treDA.
TREBLE: I Lit.: triguRa (f. RA).II In music: tAra (f. rA).III Verb: triguRI- karoti or triguRayati.
TREBLE , a. triguRaH -RA -RaM, triviDaH -DA -DaM, trigataH -tA -taM.
TREBLE , s. (In music) uccasvanaH, uccasvaraH, tIkzRasvaraH.
To TREBLE , v. a. triguRIkf, triguRa (nom. triguRayati -yituM).
TREBLY: (1) treDA or triDA;(2) triguRam (= three- -fold).
TREBLY , adv. triguRaM, triDA, treDA, triviDaM, vAratrayaM.
Tree, s. vfkzaH, taruH, drumaH, pAdapaH, vanaspatiH, SAKin m., anokahaH, viwapin m., kuwaH, sAlaH, palASin m., druH, agamaH, agaH; and ruha-h with ‘Earth’ q. v., kziti-mahI-pfTivI-ruhaH-h m. &c.

TREE: (1) vfkzaH, t.-planter: vfkzaropayitA, He.; (2) taruH, who wear bark of t. s: taruvalkavAsas (mfn.), R. viii. 11.;(2) drumaH, full of t. s: drumavat (f. tI), R. ix. 26.;(4) pAdapaH, a t. with thick shade: GanacCAyaH pAdapaH, He.;(5) vanaspatiH (= large t.), made of five t. s: paYca- vanaspatiracitaH, V. m. 79. 39.;(6) mahIruhaH; (7) SAKin (m.);(8) duH;(9) anokahaH; (10) vanarAjiH.

TREE , s. vfkzaH, taruH m., drumaH, pAdapaH, druH m., vanaspatiH m., vanarAjiH m., kzitiruhaH, mahIruhaH, BUruhaH, PalagrAhI m. (n), PaladaH, pallavI m. (n), rohiH m., avaniruw m. (h), avaniruhaH, skanDI m. (n), vi- wapI m., SAKI m., aMhripaH, gacCaH, patrI m., kuWaH, kuwaH, agamaH, palASI m., SAlaH, sAlaH, anokahaH, vAnaspatyaH; ‘a village tree, held in veneration,’ cEtyaH; ‘relating to a tree,’ vArkzaH -rkzI -rkzaM.
Trefoil, a. triparRa, tridala.
TREFOIL: (1) triparRaH (?);(2) tridalaH;(3) tripatraH (?).
TREFOIL , s. triparRaH -rRA -rRaM, tripatraH -trA -traM, tridalA.
Trellis, s. jAlaM, gavAkzajAlaM.
TRELLIS , TRELLIS-WORK, s. jAlaM -lakaM, jAlikA, gavAkzajAlaM.

Tremble, v. i. vi-tras 1, 4 P, (with fear) pra-vep 1 A, kaMp 1 A, sPur 6 P, pra-vi-°, spaMd 1 A; pra-vi-hval 1 P. [Trembl]ing, Tremulous, a. kaMpamAna, vepaTumat, sakaMpa, tarala, vilola, capala, caMcala; uttrasta, kAtara (with fear); Bagna, gadgada (voice); ‘in a t(rembling) voice’ svaraBaMgena, sagadgadaM. Tremor, s. pra-kaMpaH, sADvasaM, vepaTuH, vepanaM, sPuraRaM, uttrAsaH, kAtaratA, &c.
TREMBLE: (1) vepate, pra- (vep, c. 1.), t. ing mother: vepamAnajananI, R. xi. 65.;(2) kampate, pra- (kamp, c. 1.), he made the kings t.: nfpa- gaRamasAvakampayat, Si. xv. 3.
To TREMBLE , v. n. kamp (c. 1. kampate -mpituM), vep (c. 1. vepate -pituM), sPur (c. 6. sPurati -rituM), capala (nom. capalAyate). See To QUIVER, SHAKE, v. n.
TREMBLING (subs.): kampaH: v. Tremor.
TREMBLING , part. kampamAnaH -nA -naM, vepamAnaH &c., jAtakampaH -mpA -mpaM, jAtavepaTuH -TuH -Tu, ullalaH -lA -laM, ullalan -lantI &c., See QUIVERING.
TREMBLING , s. kampAH -mpanaM, prakampaH, utkampaH, vepanaM, pravepaRaM, sPuraRaM viDuvanaM, ullalaH; ‘of voice,’ svaraBaNgaH, see QUIVERING, s.
Tremendous, a. mahApramARa, atibfhat; Gora, dAruRa, atiguru.
TREMENDOUS: Gora (f. rA): v. Immense, huge, terrible.
TREMENDOUS , a. atidAruRaH -RA -RaM, atiBayAnakaH, see FEARFUL.
TREMENDOUSLY: Goram: v. Also immensely, exceedingly.
TREMENDOUSNESS: GoratA: v. Also greatness, largeness.
TREMOR: (1) vepaTuH, some were in t.: kecidvepaTu- mAseduH, B. iv. 43.;(2) kampaH, pra-, already t. from old age: prAgeva jarasA kampaH, Sa. vi. 29.
TREMOR , s. vepaTuH m., kampaH, vepanaM, sPuraRaM, sPUrttiH f., calatvaM, viDUtiH f., viDutiH f., viDUnanaM, gAtrakampaH. See TREMBLING, s.
TREMULOUS: (1) kampra (f. mprA);(2) vepamAna (f. nA);(3) kampamAna (f. nA);(4) lola (f. lA), vyA- (= shaking: of things).

TREMULOUS , a. lolaH -lA -laM, caYcalaH &c., capalaH &c., kampanaH -nA -naM, kampraH -mprA -mpraM, sakampaH -mpA -mpaM, kampAnvitaH -tA -taM, sotkampaH &c., taralaH -lA -laM, taralitaH -tA -taM, lulitaH &c., vyAlolaH -lA -laM, cawulaH &c., sPUrttimAn -matI &c.
TREMULOUSLY , adv. sakampaM, savepanaM, sasPuraRaM, caYcalaM, taralaM.
TREMULOUSNESS , s. lolatA, caYcalatA, capalatA, sakampatA -tvaM.
Trench, s. KAtaM, pariKA, nAlI, praRAlI; AlavAlaM (of a tree). v. t. Kan 1 P; ‘t(rench) upon’ Akram 1 U, 4 P; See Encroach. [Trench]er, s. KanakaH. 2 kAzWapAtraM-BAjanaM.
TRENCH: I Subs.:(1) KAtam (= ditch);(2) pariKA (round a fort etc.);(3) nAlI, praRAlI (channel for irrigation);(4) AlavAlam (round a tree).II Verb: KAtaM or praRAlIM karotiH v. Also to dig.
TRENCH , s. pariKA, KAtaM, kulyA, upakulyA, parikUwaM, KallaH, see DITCH; ‘trench at the foot of a tree,’ AlavAlaM, sTAnakaM.
TRENCHER: I A digger: KanakaH.II A vessel: kAzWaBAjanam.
TRENCHER , s. kAzWamayapAtraM, kAzWamayaBAjanaM, kAzWamayaBARqaM.
Trend, vftti f., BAvaH.
TREPAN: I Subs.: perh. dantaSaNkuH, Sr.II Verb: v. To cheat, deceive.
Trepidation, s. udvegaH, saMkzoBaH, sADvaso-tkaMpaH, BayakaMpaH.
TREPIDATION: udvegaH: v. Alarm, agitation.
TREPIDATION , s. kampaH, BayakampaH, viBramaH. See TREMBLING, TERROR.
Trespass, v. ati-ut-kram 1 U, 4 P, ati-car 1 P, anaDikAraM praviS 6 P; See Transgress, Intrude, Offend. s. atikramaH, maryAdAtikramaH, amaryAdA, aparADaH, dozaH.
TRESPASS (subs.): I Lit.: atikramaH: v. Trans- -gression, offence.II In law: atikramya praveSaH (?), house-t. by night: atikramya rajanyAM gfha- praveSaH (?).
TRESPASS (v.): I Lit.: atikrAmati (kram, c. 1.).II In law: atikraBya praviSati (viS, c. 6.).III Of time: harati (hf, c. 1.).

To TRESPASS , v. a. (Pass beyond, exceed propriety) atikram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM), utkram, maryyAdAtikramaM kf, maryyAdAlaNGanaM kf, sImAtikramaRaM kf, sImollaNGanaM kf, see To TRANSGRESS, OFFEND. — (Intrude, encroach) anaDikArapUrvvam Akram or AkramaRaM kf, see To INTRUDE, &c.
TRESPASS , s. atikramaH, utkramaH, AkramaRaM, maryyAdAtikramaH, anaDikAra- praveSaH, vyaBicAraH, amaryyAdA, aparADaH, drohaH.
TRESPASSER , s. maryyAdAtikramI m. (n), anaDikArapraveSakaH.
Tress, s. kabarI, keSakalApaH; alakaH, cUrRa-kuMtalaH.
TRESS: kavarI: v. Curl, hair.
TRESS , s. alakaH, kavaraH -rI -raM, keSaveSaH, keSagarBakaH. See CURL.
TRI-OCULAR , a. trinayanaH -nI -naM, trinetraH -trA -traM, trilocanaH -nA -naM.
Triad, s. trikaM, trayaM, tritayaM.
TRIAD: (1) trayam (f. yI);(2) trikam.
TRIAD , s. trikaM, trayaM -yI; ‘the Hindū triad,’ trimUrttiH f.
TRIAL: I Examination: q. v.: parIkzA.II Judicial: vicAraH.III Affliction, calamity: kfcCram.

TRIAL , s. (Testing, proving) parIkzA -kzaRaM, anuBavaH, see TEST; ‘under trial,’ anuBUyamAnaH -nA -naM; ‘subjected to trial,’ anuBa- vArUQaH -QA -QaM. — (Experience) anuBavaH, anuBUtiH f., pratItiH f. — (Attempt) yatnaH, prayatnaH, udyogaH. — (Judicial trial) vicAraH, vyavahAradarSanaM, DargmavivecanaM; ‘day of trial,’ vicAradinaM, AhvAna- darSanaM. — (Affliction, calamity), see the words.
Triangle, s. triBujaH, trikoRaH, tryasraM. Triangular, a. trikoRa, tryasra, triBujAkAra, trikoRAkfti.

TRIANGLE: (1) triBujam, right-angled t.: kowimat or fjuBujaM triBujam, Li. 125. (samakoRatriBujam), K. d.; acute-a. t.: antarlambaM triBujam; obtuse-a. t.: bahirlambaM triBujam; base of a t.: BuH, BUmiH, kzmA, etc.;(2) tryasram;(3) tribAhukam.

TRIANGLE , s. trikoRaH -RaM, triBujaH, tryasraM, triSfNgaH -NgaM, tripuwakaH, sUciH f., trikoRAkftiH f., trikoRamUrttiH f.; ‘acute angled,’ antarlasaH; ‘equilateral,’ samatriBujaH; ‘isosceles,’ dvisamatriBujaH; ‘scalene, [Page812-a+ 51] vizamatriBujaH; ‘base of a triangle,’ BujaH; ‘segment of the base,’ abADA; ‘verticle arm,’ kowiH f.; ‘area,’ trikoRakzetraM.
TRIANGULAR: (1) trikoRa (f. RA);(2) tryasra (f. srA); etc.
TRIANGULAR , a. trikoRAkftiH -tiH -ti, trikoRAkAraH -rA -raM, triBujA- kAraH &c., tryasrAkAraH &c., tryasraH -srA -sraM.
Tribe, s. jAti f.; vargaH, varRaH (caste).
TRIBE: jAtiH: v. Caste, race, nation.

TRIBE , s. jAtiH f., vargaH, kulaM, varRaH, gaRaH, gotraM; ‘the four tribes or classes,’ caturvarRaM; these are, 1. the sacerdotal, see BRAH- MIN; 2. the military, see under MILITARY, a.; 3. the agri- cultural or mercantile, see AGRICULTURIST; 4. the servile, see SHUDRA.
TRIBRACH , s. (Foot of three short syllables) tARqavaH.
Tribulation, s. duHKaM, kleSaH, kazwaM; See Distress.
TRIBULATION: kazwam: v. Trouble, calamity.
TRIBULATION , s. kleSaH, duHKaM, saNkawaM. See DISTRESS, TROUBLE.
Tribunal, s. Darma-nyAya-AsanaM, vyavahArAsanaM; ‘sat on the t(ribunal)’ vyavahArAsanamAdade. 2 Darma-nyAya-saBA.
TRIBUNAL: I Seat of a judge: and sim. comp. s.II Court: q. v.: DarmasaBA.
TRIBUNAL , s. (Court of justice) DarmmasaBA, nyAyasaBA, DarmmaSAlA. — (Seat of a judge) DarmmAsanaM, nyAyAsanaM.
TRIBUNE: prajApAlaH.
TRIBUTARY: karada (f. dA: perh. also of rivers), who has made (other) kings t.: karadIkftaBUpAlaH, Si. ii. 9.
TRIBUTARY , a. or s. karadaH -dA -daM, SulkadaH -dA -daM, nEgamaH -mI -maM; ‘made so,’ karadIkftaH -tA -taM. — (Paid in tribute) kararUpaH &c.
Tribute, s. karaH, SulkaH-lkaM; (fig.) upahAraH; See Present. [Tribut]ary, a., s. karada; sAmaMta; ‘rendered t(ributary)’ karadIkfta. 2 (Of a river) SAKA.
TRIBUTE: I Lit.: karaH, pay in kind some t. to Yudhiṣṭhira: yuDizWirAya yaktiMcit karapaRyaM pradIyatAm, Mah. ii. 28. 15.II Fig.: upahAraH (= pre- -sent: q. v.).
TRIBUTE , s. karaH, SulkaH -lkaM, karaBAraH, upahAraH. See TAX.
Trice, s. See Twinkling. 2 rajjvA baMD 9 P or kfz 6 P.
TRICE: nimezaH, in a t.: nimezamAtreRa or mAtrAt, R. iii. 61.
TRICE (subs.): I Artifice, stratagem: q. v.: (1) Calam;(2) Cadman.II Juggler's: mAyA, in all the t. s of Śambara: Sambarasya mAyAsu.III Play: q. v.: KelA or Kelitam.
TRICE , s. nimezaH, palaM, kzaRaH, truwiH f.; ‘in a trice,’ nimezamAtreRa.
Tricentenary, s. triSatAbdaM. 2 triSatAbda-tiTi m. f.

Trick, s. CalaM, Cadman n., kapawaM, kUwopAyaH-kalpanA-prabaMDaH, apa-vyapa-deSaH, vyAjaH, kEtavaM. 2 mAyA, hastalAGavaM; (‘jugglerʼs t(rick)’). 3 kucezwA, cezwitaM; lIlA, KelanaM, durlakzaRaM. v. t. vaMc 10, pra-tF c.; See Cheat. [Trick]ery, s. See Deceit. [Trick]ster, s. vaMcakaH, kitavaH, pratArakaH.
TRICK (v.): Calayati (Cal, c. 10.): v. To deceive.

TRICK , s. (Artifice to deceive) CalaM, Cadma n. (n), vyapadeSaH, mAyA, kapaWaH, vyAjaH, kEtavaprayogaH, see FRAUD. — (Bad or strange habit) vyasanaM, durguRaM, durlakzaRaM, avalakzaRaM, cezwA, kucezwA, kzvelitaM; ‘monkey trick,’ markawacezwA, see PRANK.
TRICKED , p. p. vaYcitaH -tA -taM, vyapadizwaH -zwA -zwaM. See DECEIVED.
TRICKERY: Calam: v. Deceit, deception.
Trickle, v. i. maMdaM maMdaM sru 1 P, pari-sru, kaRaSaH-SanEH SanEH-kzar 1 P or syaMd 1 A.
TRICKLE: mandaM mandaM sravati (sru, c. 1.): v. To ooze, flow.
To TRICKLE , v. n. SanEH SanEH syand (c. 1. syandate -ndituM) or sru (c. 1. sravati, srotuM) or kzar or rI. See To OOZE, FLOW.
TRICKLING , part. SanEH SanEH syandamAnaH -nA -naM. See OOZING, part.
TRICKLING , s. syandanaM, nisyandaH, kzaraRaM, sravaH, srAvaH. See OOZING, s.
TRICKSTER: vaYcaka (f. YcikA), pra-: v. Cheat, deceitful, rogue.
Trident, s. triSUlaM; triSiKaM, triSIrzakaM, pinAkaH-kaM (of Śiva).
TRIDENT: triSUlam, T.-handed (Śiva) SUlapARiH.
TRIDENT , s. triSUlaH -laM, triSiKaM, triSIrzakaH -kaM, pinAkaH -kaM; ‘of Śiva,’ see under ŚIVA; ‘bearer of one,’ triSUlapARiH m.
Triduan, a. tryAhika (kI f.).
TRIDUAN , a. tryAhikaH -kI -kaM, dvyahAntaritaH -tA -taM.
TRIED , p. p. parIkzitaH -tA -taM, anuBUtaH &c.; ‘person,’ upaDASuciH.
Triennial, a. trEvArzika (kI f.).
TRIENNIAL: (1) trEvArzika (f. kI);(2) tryabdika (f. kI); etc.
TRIENNIAL , a. trEvArzikaH -kI -kaM, tryAbdikaH &c., trivarzAtmakaH &c.

Trifle, v. i. bAlakavat Acar 1 P or vft 1 A; Kel 1 P; ‘t(rifle) with’ parihas 1 P; See Jest; ‘t(rifle) away’ ava-, kzip 6 P; See Spend. s. aRuH, leSaH, lavaH. 2 alpa-svalpa-vizayaH laGvarTaH. [Trifl]ing, a. laGu, nirarTaka, tucCa, kzudra, laGvarTa, su-, alpa, tfRaprAya, akiMcitkara (rI f.).
TRIFLE: I Subs.: expr. by adj.: v. Trifl- -ing.II Verb: Kelati (Kel, c. 1.): v. To play. To t. away: kzipati (kzip, c. 6.): v. To waste, spend.
TRIFLE , s. svalpavizayaH, alpavizayaH, laGuvizayaH, strIkalpavarttaH.
To TRIFLE , v. n. bAlakavad Acar, bAlakavfttiM sev or AsTA, laGuvi- zayavyApftaH -tA -taM BU, KelA (nom. KelAyati), kuq (c. 6. kuqati -qituM); ‘trifle away,’ kzip.
TRIFLER , s. laGuvizayavyApftaH -vyApArI m., kAlakzepakaH.
TRIFLING (adj.): (1) tucCa (f. cCA);(2) nirarTaka (f. kA = useless);(3) laDu (f. also GvI =light);(4) kzudra (f. drA = small).
TRIFLING , a. laGuH -GuH -Gu, svalpaH -lpA -lpaM, alpapraBAvaH -vA -vaM, laGu- praBAvaH &c., agaRanIyaH -yA -yaM, kzullakaH -kA -kaM, tfRaprAyaH -yA -yaM, tanIyAn -yasI -yaH (s). See INCONSIDERABLE.
Trifoliate, a. tridala, triparRa.
TRIFOLIATE , a. triparRaH -rRA -rRaM, tripatraH -trA -traM, tridalaH -lA -laM.
TRIGGER: avazwamBaH.
TRIGONOMETRICAL: expr. by comp., t. survey: trikoRamitimApaH.
TRIGONOMETRICAL , a. trikoRamitivizayakaH -kA -kaM -sambanDI -nDinI &c.
Trigonometry, s. trikoRamiti f.
TRIGONOMETRY: trikoRamitiH.
TRIGONOMETRY , s. trikoRamitiH f., trikoRamApanavidyA.
Trilateral, a. triBuja, tripArSva.
TRILATERAL: triBujaH (jA, jaM) and sim. comp. s.
TRILATERAL , a. triBujaH -jA -jaM, triBujAtmakaH -kA -kaM.
Triliteral, a. tryakzara.
TRILITERAL , a. tryakzarakaH -kA -kaM, tryakzararUpaH &c., trivarRaH &c.
Trill, s. svarakaMpaH. v. i. kaMp 1 A (Said of voice).
Trillion, s. daSaparArDaM.
TRILLION: daSaparArdDam or paraHparArdDam.
TRILLION , s. prayutaGanaH, DunaH; ‘hundred trillion,’ akzOhiRI.

Trim, v. t. kxp c., vi-, rac 10, parizkf 8 U. a. kxpta, su-, racita, vinIta, parizkfta. [Trim]ming, s. parikalpaH, BUzA-zaRaM, sajjA; ‘the body is not in good t(rimming)’ SarIramasAzWavaM (Mal. 1). 2 avasTA, daSA.
TRIM (v.): kalpayati (kxp, c. 10.): v. To clip, arrange, dress.
TRIM (adj.): kxpta (f. ptA): v. Neat.
TRIM, TRIMMING (subs.): parikalpaH: v. Also dress.
TRIM , a. vinItaH -tA -taM, sureKaH -KA -KaM. See NEAT.
TRIM , s. (Condition) avasTA, sTitiH f. — (Gear) sajjA.
To TRIM , v. a. virac (c. 10. -racayati -yituM), kxp (c. 10. kalpayati -yituM), susTaM -sTAM kf, susTIkf. See To ARRANGE, DRESS, CLIP.
TRIMMING , s. viracanaM -nA; ‘of a garment,’ parigrahaH.
TRINITARIAN , s. vyaktitrayEkatvavAdI m. (n), vyaktitrayAtmakadevatASrayI m., trayEkatvavAdI m., trayEkatvamatAvalambI m.
Trinity, s. trimUrti m.
TRINITY: trayEkatvam (?) “ekEva mUrtirbiBide triDA sA, K. vii. 44.
TRINITY , s. vyaktitrayEkatvaM, trayEkatvaM, vyaktitrayAtmakadevatA.
Trinket, s. kaMkaRaH-RaM; alaMkAraH; See Ornament.
TRINKET: alaNkAraH: v. Ornament.
TRINKET , s. kaNkaRaH -RaM, maRqanaM, see ORNAMENT; ‘for the hair,’ bAlapASyA, pAritaTyA; ‘for the forehead,’ lalAwikA, patrapASyA.
Trinomial, s. tripada.
TRINOMIAL , a. (In mathematics) tripadaH -dA -dI -daM.
Trio, s. trayI, trayaM, tritayaM, trikaM.
TRIO: trayam or trayI, Si. ii. 8.
TRIO , s. trayaM -yI, trikaM, tritayaM, trikUwaM. See TRIAD.
Trip, v. i. pra-, sKal 1 P; vi-, Bram 1, 4 P, vi-cal 1 P. 2 laGu cal-r 1 P. v. t. pra-, sKal c. s. sKalitaM, sKalanaM, BramaRaM, paryawanaM.
TRIP (subs.): I An excursion: BramaRam.II A tremble: sKalitam.
TRIP (v.): I Intrans.: sKalati (sKal, c. 1.). II Trans.: sKalayati (c. of sKal).
To TRIP , v. a. (Trip up) sKal in caus. (sKalayati -yituM), parapAdam Ahatya pat (c. 10. pAtayati -yituM), udGAtaM kf, see To SUPPLANT.
To TRIP , v. n. sKal (c. 1. sKalati -lituM), prasKal, sKalanaM kf, see To STUMBLE. — (Walk lightly) laGugatyA kram or car or cal.
TRIP , s. (Stumble) sKalanaM, udGAtaH. — (Excursion) BramaRaM, IzadBramaRaM.
Tripartite, a. triBAga, triKaMqa.
TRIPARTITE: triBAga- or treDA-viBakta (f. ktA) and sim. comp. s.
TRIPARTITE , a. triBAgaH -gA -gaM, triKaRqaH -RqA -RqaM, tryaMSaH -SA -SaM.
Tripe, s. jaWaraM, udaraM, aMtrARi (pl.).
TRIPE: I Entrails: antrARi (n. pl.).II Stomach: jaWaram.
TRIPE , s. antraM, udaraM, paSvantraM. See ENTRAILS.
Triped, s. tripadI.
TRIPETALOUS , a. tridalaH -lA -laM, tridalaviSizwaH -zwA -zwaM.
Triple, a. triguRa, triviDa, triDA-treDA ind. v. t. triguRIkf 8 U. Triplicate, a. triguRa, trirAvfta. s. tftIyaH pratileKaH. Triplicity, s. trEviDyaM, trEguRyaM.
TRIPLE , TRIPLED, a. triguRaH -RA -RaM, triviDaH -DA -DaM, trirUpaH -pA -paM, trigataH -tA -taM, trivft m. f. n., triDA ind., treDA ind.
TRIPLER: I Lit.: trikam.II Of verses: viSezakam.
TRIPLICITY , s. trEviDyaM, triviDatvaM, trEguRyaM, trirUpatA.
Tripod, s. tripadaM, AsanaM.
TRIPOD: tripadI.
TRIPOD , TRIPOS, s. (Any thing with three feet) tripadaM, tripAdaM.
TRIPOS: mathematical t.: gaRitaparIkzA (?).
Trisect, v. t. samaM triDA viBaj 7 P.
TRISYLLABIC: (1) tryakzara (f. rA);(2) trika (f. kA).
TRISYLLABIC , a. tryakzaraH -rA -raM, tryakzarI -riRI &c., tryackaH -ckA -ckaM.
Trisyllable, s. tryakzaraM, trikaM.
TRISYLLABLE: (1) tryakzaram;(2) trikam, ‘ma’ is the technical name of a t. whose every syllable is long: sarvagurostrikasya masaMjYA pariBAzyate, P. h.
TRISYLLABLE , s. tryakzaraSabdaH, tryakzaraviSizwaSabdaH.
Trite, a. kzuRRa, jIrRa, ucCizwa, suprasidDa, sadAvyavahArita.
TRITE: (1) kzuRRa (f. RRA), if one leaves out the subject of Rāma, because it is t.: yadi kzuRRaM pUrvEriti jahati rAmasya caritam, A. n. i. 9.
TRITE , a. ucCizwaH -zwA -zwaM, lokocCizwaH &c., jIrRaH -rRA -rRaM.
TRITENESS , s. ucCizwatA, lokocCizwatA, prasidDatA, jIrRatA.
TRITHEISM , s. devatrayavAdaH, devatrayamataM, tridevavAdaH.
Triturate, v. t. saMGfz 1 P, nizpiz 7 P. See Grind.
To TRITURATE , v. a. cUrR, piz, saMGfz, saMGarzaM kf. See To GRIND.
TRITURATION , s. saNGarzaH -rzaRaM, vimardaH -rdanaM, parimalaH, see GRINDING.

Triumph, v. i. vi-parA-ji 1 A, parABU 1 P. 2 vijayotsavaM kf 8 U. s. vi-, jayaH. 2 vijayotsavaH, jayayAtrA. 3 jayaharzaH-ullAsaH; AnaMdahetuH. [Triumph]al, a. jaya in comp.; jaya-toraRaM ‘t(riumphal) arch’; ‘t(riumphal) column’ jayastaMBaH. [Triumph]ant, a. jEtra (trI f.), jayaSAlin, jetf, jizRu, vi-, jayin, prAptajaya, kzatAri. [Triumph]antly, adv. sajayaM, sajayaGozaM.
TRIUMPH (subs.): I Victory: q. v.: vijayaH. II Roman: vijayotsavaH.
TRIUMPH (v.): I Exalt, celebrate victory: vijayotsavaM karoti.II To gain victory, win: q. v.: vijayate (ji, c. 1.).III To thrive, prosper: q. v.
TRIUMPH , s. (Pomp of a victory) jayayAtrA, vijayayAtrA, jayotsavaH. — (Victory) vijayaH, jayaH, jayaSrIH f. — (Joy for victory) jayA- nandaH, jayaharzaH, jayollAsaH, jayagarvaH.

To TRIUMPH , v. n. (Celebrate victory with pomp) jayayAtrAM kf, vijayayAtrAM kf, jayotsavaM kf. — (Obtain victory) viji (c. 1. -jayate -jetuM), ji, vijayI BU. — (Exult) jayajayaSabdaM kf, jayAnandaM kf.
TRIUMPHAL: jaya- or vijaya- in comp., t. arch: jayatoraRam.
TRIUMPHAL , a. jaya or vijaya in comp.; ‘triumphal arch,’ jayatoraRaH.
TRIUMPHANT: (1) jayin (f. nI), vi-, in the t. seat: jayinyAsane, Ki. xviii. 38.;(2) jEtra (f. trI);(3) jitvara (f. rI), vi-;(4) jayaSAlin (f. nI); and sim. comp. s.

TRIUMPHANT , a. vijayI -yinI -yi (n), jayI &c., jayavAn -vatI -vat (t), vijayavAn &c., vijayamAnaH -nA -naM, jayaSAlI &c., jayayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, prAptajayaH -yA -yaM, labDajayaH &c., jizRuH -zRuH -zRu, jetA -trI -tf (tf), jEtraH -trI -traM, jayAnandI &c., jitaSatruH -truH -tru, kzatAriH -riH -ri.
TRIUMPHANTLY , adv. savijayaM, sajayAnandaM, sajayadarpaM, jayadarpeRa.
Triumvirate, s. trinarapraButvaM.
TRIUMVIRATE: trijanaSAsanam and sim. comp. s (?).
TRIUMVIRATE , s. puruzatrayapraButvaM, vyaktitrayapraButvaM.
TRIUNE: trikEka (f. kA) (?) and sim. comp. s.
TRIUNE , a. tryekaH -kA -kaM, trayAtmakEkaH -kA -kaM.
TRIVIAL , a. laGuH -GuH -GvI -Gu, kzudraH -drA -draM. See TRIFLING.
TRIVIALITY: (1) tucCatA;(2) kzudratA (= small- -ness);(3) nirarTakatA (= uselessness): v. Also trifle.
TRIVIALNESS , s. laGutA, lAGavaM, kzudratA, atikzudratA, svalpatA.
TROCHEE: (1) tAlaH (Wilson);(2) galO (dual); (3) Adigurudvikam.
TROCHEE , s. (Foot of two syllables) tAlaH, galaH, galapadaM.
TRODDEN , p. p. pAdamarditaH -tA -taM, pAdamfditaH &c., pAdAhataH &c., cara- RAhataH &c., caraRAnamitaH -tA -taM, pAdaspfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, padaspfzwaH &c.
Troll, v. i. pari-Bram 1, 4 P. s. See Goblin.
Trolly ([Troll]ey), hastavAhyaM yAnaM.
Troop, s. (‘T(roop)s’) sEnikAH, padAtayaH, sEnyaM; See Force. 2 gulmaH-lmaM, dalaM. 3 yUTaM, gaRaH, kadaMbaH, vfMdaM, kulaM; See Herd. [Troop]er, s. sAdin m., aSvArohaH.
TROOP: I In pl.: sEnikAH or sEnyAH: v. Also forces, army.II Company: q. v.: gulmaH. III Collection, multitude: q. v.: yUTam.
TROOP , s. (Band, collection) gaRaH, vfndaM, yUTaM, saNGaH, samUhaH, see MUL- TITUDE; ‘in troops,’ yUTaSas. — (Of cavalry) aSvArUQasEnikagulmaH. — (Troops) sEnyAH m. pl., sEnikAH m. pl., see FORCES.
TROOPER: sAdin (m.): v. Horseman.
TROOPER , s. aSvArUQasEnikaH, aSvArUQasEnyaH, see HORSEMAN.
Trope, s. rUpakaM.
TROPE: rUpakam: v. Metaphor, figure.
TROPE , s. rUpakaM, vyaYjanaM. See METAPHOR, FIGURE.
Trophy, s. jayastaMBaH-cihnaM.
TROPHY: (1) jayastamBaH (column);(2) vijaya- liNgam (mark); etc.
TROPHY , s. (Triumphal column) jayastamBaH, raRastamBaH, yUpaH -paM. — (Memorial of victory) jayacihnaM, jayasmArakaM.
Tropic, s. ayanavfttaM, krAMtivalayaM-maMqalaM. [Tropic]al, a. Ex. by (s.) in comp.
TROPIC: (1) ayanavfttam (?). Ph.: the space with- in the t. s.: krAntivalayaH.
TROPIC , s. (The line) ayanasImA, krAntisImA, dakziRottarAyaRasImA, ayanAntaH. — (Tropics) krAntivalayaH, krAntivfttaM, ayanavfttaM, krAntimaRqalaM.
TROPICAL: I Metaphorical: q. v.II Belong- -ing to the t. s: krAntivalaya- in comp.
TROPICAL , a. krAntivalayasambanDI &c., krAntivfttasambanDI &c., krAntivala- yAntargataH -tA -taM. — (Metaphorical), see the word.
Trot, s. Do(DO)rita-takaM. v. i. Doritena yA 2 P or gam 1 P.
TROT: I Subs.: Do(DI)rItam, -kam.II Verb: Doritakena yAti (yA, c. 2.) etc.: v. To go.
TROT , s. DoritaM -takaM, DOritakaM, DoraRaM, DAritaM -takaM, DOryyaM, DArA.
To TROT , v. n. Dor (c. 1. Dorati -rituM), DoraRaM kf, DoritaM kf.
Troth, s. viSvAsaH, pratyayaH; ‘by my t(roth)’ satyameva, yadi tava mayi viSvAsaH.
TROTH: viSvAsaH: v. Faith.
TROTH , s. BaktiH f., pratyayaH, viSvAsaH. See FAITH, TRUTH, FIDELITY.
TROTTER: DoritakuSalo hayaH and sim. comp. s.

Trouble, s. kazwaM, duHKaM, pIqA, kleSaH, pra-A-yAsaH, KedaH, kfcCraM; A-vi-pad f., durdaSA, bADA, uparoDaH. 2 yatnaH, udyamaH; See Pains. 3 kaMwakaH, AyAsakaH, SalyaM. v. t. bAD 1 A, pIq 10, kliS 9 P, uparuD 7 U, Ayas c.; saM-pari-tap c.; See Afflict; ‘t(roubl)ed at heart’ KinnAMtaHkaraRa, udvignacitta and sim. comp.; ‘Oh! do not t(rouble) yourself’ alamAtmAnamAyAsya, kftaM kftaM AyA-sena. [Troubl]ed, a. bADita, pIqita &c., vyagra, udvigna, kAtara, vihvala, Arta, viklava. [Trouble]some, a. kazwa-pIqA-kara (rI f.), pIqAprada, kleSAvaha, duHKAvaha, duzwa, AyAsahetuka; ‘a t(roublesome) fellow’ kaMwakaH. Troublous, a. kzubDa, sopaplava.
TROUBLE (subs.): (1) kazwam (in every sense); v. Distress, pain, calamity;(2) kleSaH (=toil), forgot her t. s: kleSaM visasmAra, M. n. on Ku. v. 86.

TROUBLE (v.): (1) kliSnAti, pari-, saM- (kliS, c. 9.), even the keeping up of what is gained t. s: kliSnAti labDaparipAlanavfttireva, Sa. v. 5.;(2) bADate; (bAD, c. 1. = harass), t. good citizens: bADante BadrikAH prajAH, Mu.;(2) pIqayati (pIq, c. 10.): v. To pain.: Ph.: don't t. yourself: alamalamAyAsena, S. iii.

To TROUBLE , v. a. Ayas (c. 10. -yAsayati -yituM), bAD (c. 1. bADate DituM), uparuD (c. 7. -ruRadDi -rodDuM), kliS, tap, vyAkulIkf, ard, vyaT, vyagraM -grAM kf, kazwaM kf, kleSaM kf or dA, kfcCraM dA, see To HARASS; ‘dont trouble yourself,’ alam AyAsena.

TROUBLE , s. kleSaH, kazwaM, AyAsaH, prayAsaH, duHKaM, bADaH -DA, uparoDaH, pIqA, vyaTA, tApaH, santApaH, Apad f., ApattiH f., vipad, vipattiH f., durdaSA, duHsTitiH f., kazwAvasTA, vyasanaM, upadravaH, saNkawaM, see CALAMITY, PERPLEXITY; ‘a sea of trouble,’ vipatsAgaraH. — (Pains) yatnaH, see PAINS. — (That which gives annoyance) kaRwakaH -kaM, SalyaM, duHKaM.

TROUBLED , p. p. bADitaH -tA -taM, kleSitaH &c., klizwaH -zwA -zwaM, uparudDaH -dDA -dDaM, duHKitaH -tA -taM, santApitaH &c., kAtaraH -rA -raM, vyagraH -grA -graM, udvignaH -gnA -gnaM, vihvalaH -lA -laM, Artta in comp.; as, ‘troubled with thirst,’ tfzArttaH -rttA -rttaM; ‘with hunger,’ kzuDArttaH &c.
TROUBLESOME: (1) kazwakara (f. rI);(2) kleSAvaha (f. hA), and sim. deriv. Ph.: a t. fellow: kaRwakaH (= thorn).

TROUBLESOME , a. kazwakaraH -rA -raM, kazwakArakaH -kA -kaM, kazwAvahaH -hA -haM, kleSakArI -riRI -ri (n), kleSAvahaH -hA -haM, duHKAvahaH &c., SramA- vahaH &c., AyAsahetukaH -kA -kaM, kazwaH -zwA -zwaM, duzwaH &c., vizamaH -mA -maM, durnivahaH -hA -haM, sakaRwakaH -kA -kaM; ‘a troublesome fellow,’ kaRwakaH.
TROUBLOUS: t. sea: kzubDArRavaH: t. misery: bADakaM kazwam.
TROUBLOUS , a. sopadravaH -vA -vaM, sopaplavaH &c. See CALAMITOUS.
Trough, s. droRi-RI f.
TROUGH: droRiH(RI).
TROUGH , s. droRiH -RI f., druRiH -RI f.; ‘for watering cattle,’ nipAnaM, prapA, AhAvaH, puRyaM.
Troupe, s. saMGaH.
TROUSERS: aDarAvAraH, and sim. comp. s.
TROUT: matsyaviSezaH.
Trow, v. t. Srad-DA 8 U, prati-i 2 P
Trowel, s. karRI f.
TROWEL: (1) karRI (?);(2) karRISaH (?).
TROWEL , s. (Of masons) karRI, lepanayantraM.
Trowsers, s. jaMGAtrARaM-vastraM.
TROWSERS , s. pl. jaNGAvastraM, kawivastraM, jaNGApariDAnaM, kaYcukaH.
Truant, a. kAryaparANmuKa (KI f.); alasa; ‘to be t(raunt)’ alasavat Acar 1 P.
TRUANT: karmaparANmuKa (f. KI): v. Idle, lazy.
TRUANT , a. karmmavimuKaH -KA -KaM, karmmaparANmuKaH &c., vilambI -mbinI -mbi (n), alasaH -sA -saM; ‘to play truant,’ karmmavimuKaH -KA -KaM BU, vilamb (c. 1. -lambate -mbituM), alasavad Acar.
Truce, s. yudDaviSrAmaH, yudDanivftti f., ava-hAraH; ‘t(ruce) to’ ex. by viram 1 P, alaM (with instr.); ‘t(ruce) to your jest’ alaM pari-hAsena ‘t(ruce) to your impadence’ viramAti-prasaMgAt (U. 5).
TRUCE: I Peace: q. v.; sanDiH.II Ceassa- -tion: virAmaH, a t. to your frolics: viramatu tava KelA.
TRUCE , s. avahAraH, sAvaDikasanDiH m., nirUpitakAlaparyyantA yudDanivfttiH f.; ‘a truce to jesting,’ viramatu parihAsaH.
Truck, s. SakawaH-waM; See Cart.
TRUCK: I A cart: SakawaH.II Barter: q. v.
TRUCK , s. kzudracakraH SakawaH, nIcacakraM dravyavAhanaM, nIcaSakawaH.
TRUCKLE: cAwu karotiH v. To flatter.
To TRUCKLE , v. n. atyanuroDaM kf, CandonuroDaM kf, CandonuvfttiM kf.
Truculent, a. krUra, nizWura, nirdaya.
TRUCULENT: krUra (f. rA): v. Savage, cruel.
TRUCULENT , a. krUraH -rA -raM, nizWuraH &c. See SAVAGE.
Trudge, v. i. SanEH-maMdaM-vraj or cal 1 P. padByAM cal.
TRUDGE: manTaraM calati (cal, c. 1.) or vrajati (vraj, c. 1.).
To TRUDGE , v. n. pAdAByAM vraj or car, AyAsena vraj.

True, a. satya, taTya, avitaTa, fta, yaTArTa, vAstavika (kI f.), mat pr.; akftrima, akftaka (not feigned). 2 yukta, upapanna; ‘what you say is t(rue)’ yuktaM Aha BavAn; ‘t(rue) to oneʼs engagements’ satyasaMDa-pratijYa-vrat. [Tru]ly, adv. atyaM, vastutaH, yaTArTataH, paramArTataH, tattvataH; ‘affection t(ruly) so called’ paramArTataH, prema; ‘Parantapa t(ruly) so called’ paraMtapo nAma yaTArTanAmA (R. vi. 21); DruvasidDerapi yaTArTanAmnaH sidDiM na manyate (M. 4) ‘true to his name’, ‘t(ruly) so called’. Truism, s. satyaM, svataH-sidDavacanaM. Truth, s. taTyaM, satyaM, avitaTaM, ftaM, tattvaM, BUtArTaH, paramArTaH; tattvArTaH. 2 satyatA, yaTArTatA, yATArTyaM; ‘in t(ruth)’ satyameva, Kalu, nUnaM; ‘to tell you the t(ruth)’ yatsatyaM, vastutaH. [Truth]ful, a. satyaH See (a.). 2 (Of persons) satyavAdin, yaTArTavaktf-vAdin, taTyaBAzin.

TRUE: (1) satya (f. tyA), whose blessings are t.: (i. e. not falsified) satyASis (mfn.), Ki.; one not t. to his words: asatyasanDa (f. nDA), H.; (2) taTya (f. TyA), one whose sayings are t.: taTyagir (mfn.), R.;(3) yaTArTa (f. rTA = actual real: q. v.);(4) vAstavika (f. kI = 3): v. Also genuine, false. Ph.: it is t.: satyam; it is very t.: yuktam, upapannam (proper).

TRUE , a. (Not false) satyaH -tyA -tyaM, taTyaH -TyA -TyaM, yaTArTaH -rTA -rTaM, samyaN -mIcI -myak (k), samIcInaH -nA -naM, ftaH -tA -taM, satyavAn -vatI &c., upapannaH -nnA -nnaM, sidDaH -dDA -dDaM, see GENUINE, REAL, EXACT; ‘true and false,’ sadasat; ‘it is very true,’ yuktaM, yujyate, upapannaM. — (True to obligations, keeping faith) satya- pratijYaH -jYA -jYaM, satyasanDaH -nDA -nDaM, satyaSIlaH -lA -laM, satyavrataH -tA -taM, see HONEST, FAITHFUL.
TRUENESS , s. satyatA, taTyatA, yaTArTatA, samyaktvaM. See TRUTH.
TRUISM: satyam: v. Truth.
TRUISM , s. svataHspazwavAkyaM, svataHpramARakavacanaM, svataHsidDavAkyaM.
TRULY: (1) satyam;(2) taTyam;(3) vastutaH (= in fact);(4) yaTArTataH (= really).
TRULY , adv. satyaM, yaTArTaM -rTatas, arTatas, tattvatas, vastutas, samyak, paramArTatas, aYjasA, evaM. See REALLY, CERTAINLY.
Trump, v. t. kxp c., sakUwaM nirmA 3 A; See Fabricate. Trumpery, a. asAra, kftrima, kUwa in comp. s. asAra-tucCa-dravyaM.
TRUMP: I Subs.: raNgaH (?).II Verb: tarpayati (c. of tfp).
TRUMPERY: expr. by adj. asAra (f. rA): v. Trifling or kftrima (f. mA = counterfeit, false).
TRUMPERY , s. asAradravyaM, tucCadravyaM, ucCizwaM. See TRASH.
Trumpet, s. tUryaM, tUrI. 2 (Flower) pAwalA-liH, moGA, kAcasTAlI, PaleruhA, kfzRavfMtA, kuberAkzI. v. t. ud-Guz 10, prakAS c., uccEH praKyA c. (KyApayati). [Trumpet]er, s. tUryavAdakaH. 2 udGozakaH.
TRUMPET: I Subs.: tUrI.II Verb: v. To proclaim.
TRUMPET , s. (Instrument) tUrI, raRatUrI. — (Flower) pAwaliH m. f., pAwalA, PaleruhA, kfzRavfntA, kuverAkzI, amoGA, moGA, kAcasTAlI, kAlI, sTAlI, toyapuzpI, toyaprazWA, toyADivAsinI.
To TRUMPET , v. a. tUrIvAdanapUrvvaM prakAS. See To PUBLISH.
TRUMPET-FLOWER: pAwalA (liH, also lam for the flower only, Sa. i. 3.).
TRUMPETER: I Lit.: tUrIvAdaH, -kaH.II Pro- -claimer: udGozayitf (f. trI).
TRUMPETER , s. tUrIvAdakaH, raRatUrIvAdakaH, tUrIDmaH.
Truncate, v. t. lU 9 U, avacCid 7 P.
Truncheon, s. yazwi f., daMqaH, gadA.
TRUNCHEON: (1) daRqaH;(2) yazwiH.
TRUNCHEON , s. gadA, yazwiH m., daRqaH. See CLUB, CUDGEL.

Trunk, s. (Of the body) kabaMDaH, apamUrDaka-levaraM. 2 (Of trees) skaMDaH, pra-, kAMqaH-qaM; ‘t(runk) with the branches lopped off’ sTARuH. 3 (Of elephants) SuMqaH, SuMqA, daMqaH, hastaH, karaH. 4 BAMqaM. 5 agra-muKya-BAgaH.

TRUNK: I Of an elephant:(1) SuRqaH, -RqA, -daRqaH, a small t.: SuRqAraH, Vi. i. 53.;(2) hastaH, R. v. 45.;(3) karaH, by the t. s of elephants: nAgakarEH, M. n.II Of the body:(1) kabanDaH (= headless t.), saw their own t. s dancing on the ground: Buvi nftyantO svakabanDAvapaSyatAm, Ku. xvi. 49.;(2) gAtram (= body).III Of a tree: (1) skanDaH;(2) kARqa (mn.), pra-;(3) sTARuH (of a lopped tree). Ph.: grand t. road: sumahA- mArgaH (?).

TRUNK , s. (Of a tree) skanDaH, prakARqaH -RqaM, kARqaH -RqaM, gaRqiH m.; ‘of a lopped tree,’ sTARuH m. -Ru n., DruvaH, SaNkuH m. — (Of the body) SarIrakARqaH -RqaM; ‘headless trunk,’ kabanDaH, apamUrdDaka- levaraM. — (Main body) muKyaBAgaH. — (Of an elephant) SuRqA, SuRqAdaRqaH, hastaH, karaH, BujaH. — (Chest, box) BARqaM.
Truss, s. pawwaH, baMDanaM. 2 (tfRa-)kUrcaH, BAraH. v. t. kIl 10, saMbaMD 9 P, saMsaMj c.
TRUSS: I Bandage: pawwaH.II Bandle; kUrccaH.
TRUSS , s. (Of hay, &c.) tfRakUrccaH, tfRaBAraH, tfRagucCaH. — (Bandage) pawwaH -wwakaH, kavalikA, ADAraH, banDanaM.
To TRUSS , v. a. sambanD, kUrccIkf, kIl (c. 10. kIlayati -yituM).

Trust, v. t. viSvas 2 P, prati-i 2 P; See Believe. 2 nikzip 6 P, saM, f c. (arpayati), nyas 4 U; See Entrust. v. i. Ex. by Sure, q. v.; ‘learn to t(rust) in God’ ISvarAsakta-ISvarADIna-citto Bava, ISvaraM SaraRaM prapadyasva; ‘t(rust) to’ A-ava-laMb 1 A, ASri 1 U. s. viSvAsaH, viSraMBaH, pratyayaH. 2 nikzepaH, nyAsaH. 3 kAlikA, udDAraH. [Trust]ee, s. nikzepaDArin m. [Trust]ing, a. viSvA-sin, viSvasta; ‘t(rusting) to the strength of his own arms’ svaBujabalamavalaMbya. [Trust]-worthy, [Trust]y, a. viSvasanIya, viSvAsya, viSvAsArha, viSvAsayogya, viSraMBAspadaM-pAtraM-BUmiH, Apta.

TRUST (subs.): I Confidence:(1) viSvAsaH, never repose your t. on women and courts: viSvAso nEva kartavyaH strIzu rAjakulezu ca, H.;(2) viSramBaH, out of t.: viSramBataH, Mu. v. 7.;(3) pratyayaH, give him things on my t.: matpratyayenAsya dravyaM dehi, Mit. II Any thing t. ed:(1) niHkzepaH;(2) nyAsaH, Ph.: t.-property: viSvAsaDanam.
TRUST (v.): I To believe, confide: q. v.: viSvasiti (Svas, c. 1.).II To entrust: q. v.: nyasyati (as, c. 4.).

TRUST , s. (Confidence) viSvAsaH, pratyayaH, viSramBaH, nizWA, samASvAsaH, samprasAdaM, see CONFIDENCE, RELIANCE; ‘breach of trust,’ viSvAsaBaNgaH, viSvAsaGAtaH, pratyayaBaNgaH, praRayaBaNgaH. — (Charge) nyAsaH, nikzepaH. — (Credit) kAlikA, udDAraH; ‘to buy on trust,’ udDAraM kf.
To TRUST , v. a. (Confide in) viSvas (c. 2. -Svasiti -tuM), samASvas, see To CONFIDE, v. n. — (Commit in confidence) samf in caus., see To INTRUST. — (Sell on credit) udDAraM dA.
To TRUST , v. n. (Be confident) pratyASAM kf, dfQapratyASAM kf, niScayaM kf, dfQapratyayaM kf, ASAM kf, viSvAsaM kf, niHsandehaH -hA -haM BU. — (Rely on) viSvas, see To RELY, CONFIDE, v. n.
TRUSTED , p. p. viSvastaH -stA -staM, viSvasitaH &c. See CONFIDED.
TRUSTEE: viSvAsaDanarakzitf (f. trI) and sim. comp. s.
TRUSTEE , s. nyAsaDArI m. (n), nikzepaDArI m.
TRUSTING , part. viSvAsI -sinI &c., viSvastaH &c., see CONFIDING; ‘trusting to the strength of one's own arm,’ svabAhubalamA- SritaH -tA -taM.
TRUSTWORTHINESS , s. viSvAsyatA, viSvAsArhatvaM, AptatA, viSrabDatA.
TRUSTWORTHY, TRUSTY: (1) viSvAsArha (f. rhA); (2) viSvAsayogya (f. gyA), and sim. comp. s.: v. Also confidential.

TRUSTWORTHY , TRUSTY, a. viSvAsArhaH -rhA -rhaM, viSvAsayogyaH -gyA -gyaM, viSvAsyaH -syA -syaM, AptaH -ptA -ptaM, viSvAsapAtraM, viSvAsaBUmiH f., viSrabDaH -bDA -bDaM, viSramBArhaH -rhA -rhaM, SradDArhaH &c., ahAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, aBedyaH &c.

TRUTH: I What is true:(1) satyam;(2) taTyam;(3) ftam;(4) avitaTam and sim. comp. s, t. although sweet: priyamapyamiTyA.II Trueness:(1) satyatA, -tvam;(2) taTyatA, -tvam; (3) yATArTyam or yaTArTatA;(4) tattvam. Ph.: in t.: satyam: v. Truly.

TRUTH , s. satyaM, taTyaM, ftaM, samyak, avitaTaM, tattvaM, tattvArTaH, yaTArTavacanaM, yATArTyaM, sattvaM, sattA, paramArTaH, pUtaM. — (Trueness) satyatA -tvaM, taTyatA, yaTArTatA, yATArTyaM, samyaktvaM, vAstavatvaM, yATAtaTyaM; ‘one who speaks the truth,’ satyavAdI m., see VERACIOUS; ‘speaking the truth,’ see VERACITY; ‘one who knows the truth,’ tattvavid, satya- vid; ‘investigation of truth,’ mImAMsA; ‘true state of the case,’ satyavfttaM, satyavfttAntaH. — (In truth) satyameva, vastutas, see TRULY.
TRUTHFUL: I True: satya (f. tyA).II Of men: satyavAdin (f. nI) and sim. comp. s.
TRUTHFULLY: satyam: v. Truly.
TRUTHFULNESS: (1) satyatA (of words etc.); (2) satyavAditA (of men).

Try, v. t. parIkz 1 A, anu-BU 1 P; ‘to t(ry) their strength upon a traveller’ paTi-kamAtmaSaktinikazaM kartuM. 2 (Cases) dfS 1 P, vi-car c., anusaM-DA 3 U, vi-vic 3, 7 U; See Judge; ‘t(ry)ing cases’ vyava-hAradarSanaM; dadarSa saMSayacCedyAnvyavahArAn (R. xvi. 39) ‘tried contested cases’. v. i. pra-yat 1 A, udyam 1 A, vyava-so 4 P, pravft 1 A; See Attempt; oft. ex. by desid. forms. [Try]ing, a. kazwa-pIqA-kara (rI f.), (heat &c.). Trial, s. parIkzA-kzaRaM; ‘to make a t(rial) of’ parIkz; anuBavaH; ‘under t(rial)’ anuBUyamAna. 2 vyava-hAradarSanaM, vicAraH. 3 kfcCraM, vi-A-pad f.; See Calamity, Misfortune. 4 pra-, yatnaH, udyamaH, udyogaH.

TRY: I To examine: parIkzate (Ikz, c. 1.), I have tried you forming (this) illusion: mAyAM mayodBAvya parIkzito'si, R. ii. 62.II Judicially: (1) vicArayati (c. of car);(2) paSyati (dfS, c. 1. = to see), shall not t. (cases) on these days: tiTizvAsu na paSyet, Mit.III To attempt, endeavour: q. v.: yatate, I will t. to save his life: prARarakzaRe tAvadasya yatnamAcarAmi, K.
To TRY , v. a. (Test) parIkz (c. 1. -Ikzate -kzituM), parIkzAM kf, anuBU, jYA in des., see To TEST, PROVE, EXAMINE, INVESTIGATE.

To TRY , v. n. (Endeavour) yat (c. 1. yatate -tituM), prayat, yatnaM kf. [Page814-a+ 51] prayatnaM kf, cezw, vyavaso, udyam, Gaw, upakram, udyanaM kf, udyogaM kf; ‘they tried to kill me,’ te mAM hantum udyatAH or vyavasitAH; ‘he tries to drink the water,’ jalaM pAtuM vyavasyati. Sometimes expressed by the desid. form; as, ‘he tries to recollect,’ susmUrzate.
TRYING (adj.): (1) kazwakara (f. rI);(2) by subs. kfcCram: v. Difficulty.
TRYING , part. or a. parIkzakaH -kA -kaM, parIkzAkArI -riRI -ri (n).
Tryst, s. saMketasTAnaM. 2 samAgamasaMketaH.
Tub, s. droRi-RI f.
TUB: droRiH (rRA), golden t.: kaRakamayadroRI, K.
TUB , s. droRI -RiH f., druRI -RiH f.; ‘bathing tub,’ snAnadroRI -RiH f.
Tube, s. nAlaH-lI-laM, na(nA)likA, nAqi-qI f., suziraM, praRAlaH-lI. Tubular, a. nAlAkfti, nAqIrUpa.
TUBE: (1) nAlaH (lI, laM);(2) nAlikA (?).
TUBE , s. nalikA, nAlaH -lI -liH -lA -laM, nAqI -qiH f., praRAlaH -lI -likA, nalaH, suziH f., suziraM; ‘glass tube,’ kAcanAlaH.
Tuber, s. kaMdaH-daM. [Tuber]ous, a. graMTila, graMTi-mat, kaMdin.
TUBER: kanda (mfn.).
TUBER , s. (Bulbous root) kandaH -ndaM.
Tubercle, s. sUkzmavraRaH, graMTiH.
TUBERCLE: sUkzmavraRa and sim. comp. s.
TUBERCLE , s. sUkzmavraRaH, sUkzmagulmaH, granTiH m. See PIMPLE.
TUBEROUS: (1) granTila (f. lA);(2) granTimat (f. tI); etc.
TUBEROUS , a. granTilaH -lA -laM, kandI -ndinI &c. See KNOBBY.
TUBULAR: nAlAkAra (f. rA) and sim. comp. s.
TUBULAR , a. nalikAkAraH -rA -raM, nAlAkftiH -tiH -ti, nalikAkftiH &c.; ‘vessel of the body,’ nAlaH -lI, nAqiH -qI f., tantrI, DamanI.
TUCK; I Subs.: guYjaH (?).II guYjayati (nomi.).
Tuesday, s. maMgalavAsaraH.
TUESDAY: (1) maNgalavAraH;(2) kujavAraH;(3) aNgArakavAraH, M. n.
TUESDAY , s. maNgalavAraH, BOmavAraH, kulavAraH, BOmavAsaraH.
Tuft, s. cUqA, SiKA, SiKaraH-raM, SeKaraH; ‘having a t(uft)’ SiKin. 2 pallavaH; stabakaH, gucCaH, avataMsaH. [Tuft]ed, a. SiKin, SeKarita.
TUFT: I Of hair:(1) cUqA;(2) SiKA. [Page724] T. ed:(1) cUqAla (f. lA);(2) SiKin (f. nI), etc.II Of mangoes: pallavaH.
TUFT , s. SiKA, SiKaraH -raM, cUqA, SeKaraH, stavakaH, pallavaH, avataMsaH, see CLUMP, CLUSTER, BUNCH; ‘of mangoes,’ AmrapallavaH; ‘of hair,’ cUqA, keSapiRqaH, lomapiRqaH, lomagucCakaH.
TUFTED , a. cUqAvAn -vatI -vat (t), cUqAlaH -lA -laM, SiKI -KinI -Ki (n), SiKarI -riRI &c., SeKaritaH -tA -taM.
Tug, v. t. A-kfz 1 P, prayatnena kfz; See Pull.
TUG: I Verb: karzati (kfz, c. 1.): v. To pull.II A boat: potaviSezaH.
To TUG , v. a. kfz (c. 1. karzati, krazwuM), Akfz, hf. See To PULL.
Tuition, s. SikzaRaM, aDyApanaM, upadeSaH.
TUITION: SikzA: v. Instruction.

(v. i.) saMpat 1 P; See Happen. 2 jan 4 A, BU 1 P; ‘t(urn)ed out pale’ vivarRI-BUtaH, sahasA vivarRaBAvaM prapede; ‘the words of the great never t(urn) out untrue’ na hISvaravyAhftayaH kadAcitpuzRaMti loke viparI-tamarTaM (K. iii. 63). [Turn] towards, aBimuKI-saMmuKI-BU (with gen.). [Turn] up, sahasA AvirBU or prAdurBU. 2 Happen, q. v. s. AvartaH-rtanaM, Avftti f. 2 parivfttiH, parivartaH, vikaraH. 3 paryAyaH, parivfttiH; ‘by t(urn)s’ paryAyeRa, paryAya in comp.; ‘service by t(urn)s’ paryAyasevA. 4 vAraH, (SaSakasya vAraH samAyAtaH P. i. 8). 5 pra-, vfttiH, BAvaH, daSA; ‘t(urn) of mind’ cittavfttiH, manaHsvaBAvaH. 6 AkAraH, svarUpaM; ‘matters took a different t(urn)’ vastu

TURN (subs.): I Revolution: q. v.: AvartaH, -nam or AvfttiH.II Bend, curve: vaNkaH.III Change, vicissitude: q. v.: parivfttiH.IV Alternation: paryAyaH, by t. s, in t.: paryAyeRa or paryAya- in comp., Ki. xvii. 18.V Successive course: vAraH, one day a hare's t. came: aTa kadAcicCaSakasya vAraH samAyAtaH, H.VI Of mind: gatiH: v. Also inclination.VII Of ex- -pression: BaNgiH(NgI): v. Also form.VIII Of requital: good t.: upakAraH; ill t.: apakAraH. IX A short walk: parikramaH.X Course: q. v.: gatiH.XI Occasion, opportunity: avasaraH.

To TURN , v. a. To TURN , v. n. (Move round) parivft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM), vivat, viparivft, samparivft, Avft, vft, see To REVOLVE, v. n., ROLL, v. n. — (Change) parivft, see To SHIFT, v. n. — (Become sour) amlIBU, amlaBAvaM or amlatAM gam or i. — (Depend on) avalamb, samAlamb. — (Turn against) pratikUlIBU, virudDaH -dDA -dDaM BU. — (Turn away) parANmuKIBU, parANmuKaH -KA -KaM BU, vimuKIBU, vimuKaH -KA -KaM BU. — (Turn back) parivft, parAvft, nivft. — (Turn out), see To PROVE, v. n. — (Turn round) parivft. — (Turn up) prAdurBU, AvirBU, samBU, utpad, upasTA. ‘To turn’ may often be expressed by BU in comp.; as, ‘to turn black,’ kfzRIBU; ‘to turn to ashes,’ BasmasAdBU.

TURN , TURNING, s. (Revolution) parivarttanaM, AvarttaH -rttanaM, parivarttaH, parivfttiH f. — (Bend, winding) vaNkaH, vakratA; ‘of a river,’ nadIvaNkaH. — (Change) parivarttanaM, vikAraH, AvfttiH f. — (Recurring season, alternation) paryyAyaH, viparyyayaH, parivfttiH f., AvfttiH f., vAraH, vAsaraH; ‘by turns, in turn,’ paryyAyeRa, krameRa, viparyyayeRa; ‘to do by turns, take turns,’ paryyAyeRa kf, vihf. — (Occasion) kAlaH, samayaH, avasaraH, vAraH. — (Form, cast) AkAraH, AkftiH f., SIlaH -latA, BAvaH, svaBAvaH; ‘of mind,’ manaHsvaBAvaH, cittavfttiH f. — (Walk to and fro) vihAraH, IzadvihAraH, IzatparikramaH, itastataH parikramaH. — (A good turn) upakAraH. — (An ill turn) apakAraH.

TURN UP: I To appear: AvirBavati.II To occur: q. v.
TURNCOAT: svapakzatyAgin and sim. comp. s.: v. Also renegade.
