TWELFTH: I Adj.: dvAdaSaH (SI, SaM).II Subs.: dvAdaSAMSaH or dvAdaSaBAgaH.
TWELFTH , s. dvAdaSaH -SI -SaM.
Twelve, a. dvAdaSan. Twelfth, a. dvAdaSa (SI f.). s. dvAdaSAMSaH.
TWELVE: dvAdaSan (mfn.), t. hundred: dvAdaSaSatam; t. thousand: dvAdaSasahasram; t. times: dvAdaSakftvaH; lasting t. years: dvAdaSavArzikaH (kI, kaM), U. ii.
TWELVE , a. dvAdaSa m. f. n. pl. (n), dvAdaSakaH -kA -kaM.
TWELVEMONTH: for a t.: dvAdaSaBAsAn, Vas. : v. Year.
TWELVEMONTH , s. dvAdaSamAsaM, parivatsaraH, vatsaraH, varzaH.
TWENTIETH: (1) viMSaH (SI, SaM);(2) viMSatitamaH (mI, maM).
TWENTIETH , a. viMSaH -SI -SaM, viMSatitamaH -mI -maM.
Twenty, a. viMSati f. Twentieth, a. viMSa (SI f.), viMSatitama (mI f.).
TWENTY: viMSatiH, with t. arrows: viMSatyA SarEH; three hundred and t.: SatatrayaM viMSatiSca, Li. or gen.: viMSatyaDikatriSatam, Mah.

TWENTY , a. viMSatiH f. sing., dvidaSAH m. pl.; ‘he reigned twenty years,’ viMSatim abdAn rAjyaM cakAra; ‘with twenty arrows,’ viMSatyA SarEH; ‘twenty-one,’ ekaviMSatiH f. sing.; ‘two,’ dvAviM- SatiH; ‘three,’ trayoviMSatiH; ‘four,’ caturviMSatiH; ‘five,’ paYcaviM- SatiH; ‘six,’ zaqviMSatiH; ‘seven,’ saptaviMSatiH; ‘eight,’ azwA- viMSatiH; ‘nine,’ navaviMSatiH, UnatriMSat f., ekonatriMSat; ‘twenty- first,’ ekaviMSaH -SI -SaM, ekaviMSatitamaH -mI -maM; ‘aggregate of twenty,’ viMSI m. (n).
TWICE: (1) dviH;(2) dvivAram, T. born: dvijaH (jA, jaM); t. ploughed: dviguRAkftaH (tA, taM); t. as valiant as he: tasmAdviguRaparAkrAntaH (ntA, ntaM); t. a day: dvirahraH.

TWICE , adv. dviH, dvivAraM, vAradvaya, dvikftvam, dviguRaH -RA -RaM, dvikaH [Page815-b+ 51] -kA -kaM; ‘said twice,’ dviruktaH -ktA -ktaM, ‘twice-married,’ dvirUQaH -QA -QaM, punarupoQaH &c.; ‘twice ploughed,’ dviguRAkftaH -tA -taM; ‘twice-born,’ dvijaH -jA -jaM; ‘ten is twice five,’ daSa paYcaByo dviguRA Bavanti.
Twig, s. viwapaH, SAKA, praSAKA.
TWIG: (1) viwapaH (= branch), “komalaviwapAnu- kAriRO bAhU,” Sa. i. 21.;(2) praSAKA (= b. of a b.);(3) pallavaH (= sprout).
TWIG , s. upaSAKA, praSAKikA, agraSAKA, SAKikA, pallavaH.
Twilight, s. saMDyA, saMDiprakASaH, saMDyAkAlaH-samayaH, niSAdiH.

TWILIGHT: (1) sanDyA (sp. of evening), Ki. ix. 9.; morning t.: pUrvasaMDyA, Si. xi. 40. or prAtaH- sanDyA, M. n.;(2) uzas (n. = dawn);(3) dinamuKam and sim. comp. s (= 2);(4) dinAntaH and sim. comp. s. (= evening).

TWILIGHT , s. sanDyA, sanDyAkAlaH, sanDyAsamayaH, sanDiprakASaH, vikAlaH -lakaH, sanDyAMSaH, utsUraH, sabaliH m., aDvAntaM, niSAdiH m. Twilight is personified as the daughter of Brahmā, and hence called pitfprasUH f., pitfsUH f., brahmaBUtiH f.; ‘the morning twilight,’ pUrvvasanDyA, prAksanDyA, sanDyA, dinAdiH m.; ‘the two twilights,’ sanDye f. du.
Twin, a., s. yama, yamaja, yamala; ‘we are t(win) brothers’ BrAtarAvAvAM yamajO (U. 6); oft. by yamalaM, yugaM, dvaMdvaM, miTunaM, yugalaM; ‘t(win) stars’ miTunaM; ‘one of t(win)’ yamaH, yamalaH.
TWIN: (1) yamaH (mA, maM), these t. s: etO yamO, Ki. i. 36.;(2) yamajaH (jA, jaM), we are t. brothers: BrAtarAvAvAM yamajO, U.;(3) yamalaH (lA, laM), The t. s (constellation): miTunam.

TWIN , a. or s. yamaH -mA -maM, yamakaH -kA -kaM, yamalaH -lA -laM, yamajaH -jA -jaM; ‘twins,’ yamO m. du., yamakO m. du., yamaM, yamalaM, dvandvaM, yugalaM, yugaM; ‘one of twins,’ yamaH, yamakaH, nAraNgaH; ‘we are twin brothers,’ BrAtarAv AvAM yamajO.
Twine, s. sUtraM, taMtuH. v. t. ud-graMT 9 P, utKac 10, (kusumotKacitAnvalIBftaScala-yan alakAn. R. viii. 53). 2 (Itself) A-pari-vezw c., A-pari-vft c.
TWINE (subs.): sUtram: v. Thread, rope.
To TWINE , v. a. or n. parivezw, Avezw, vezw, samAvft, vyAvft.
TWINE , s. SaRasUtraM, SARasUtraM, SaRatantuH m. See THREAD.
Twinge, s. vyaTA, pIqA, vedanA, SalaH-laM, tIvravedanA. v. t. Ex. by kf with (s.).
TWINGE: I Subs.: SUlam: v. Pain.II Verb: expr. by subs.
TWINGE , s. SUlaH -laM, tIvravedanA, tIkzRavedanA, todaH.
To TWINGE , v. n. SUl (c. 1. SUlati -lituM), SUlopahataH -tA -taM BU.
TWINING , s. parivezwanaM, AvezwanaM, vezwanaM; ‘of a creeper,’ latAvezwanaM; ‘a twining plant,’ latA, latikA.

Twinkle, v. t. (Of the eye) ni-, miz 6 P, unmiz, nimIl 1 P, unmIl, nimezo-nmezaM kf. 2 sPur 6 P, taralaM-sakaMpaM-praBA 2 P or prakAS 1 A or dyut 1 A. [Twinkl]ing, s. nimi(me)zaH, nimezonmezO; ‘within the t(winkling) of the eye’ nimezamAtrAt, nimezeRa. 2 sPuraRaM, sPuritaM, taralajyoti n., praBA; ‘the eyes knowing no t(winkling)’ (papO)nimezAla-sapakzmapaMktiH (R. ii. 19), animezalocano dadarSa (Ka. 11).
TWINKLE (v.): I Of the eye: nimizati (miz, c. 6.): v. To close, open; without t. ing: nirnimezam.II To sparkle: sPurati (sPur, c. 6.).
TWINKLE, TWINKLING (subs.): I Of the eye: nimezaH, in the t. of an eye: nimezamAtrAt or -mAtreRa. II Sparkling: sPuritam.

TWINKLE , TWINKLING, s. (Of the eye) nimezaH -zakaH, nimizaH, unmezaH, nimIlanaM, unmIlanaM, vyAmIlanaM, mIlanaM, nimezonmezO m. du., nimI- lanonmIlane n. du., akzipakzmaRaH saNkocaH, akzispandanaM. — (Tremulous, sparkling) sPuraRaM, sPuritaM. — (In a twinkling) nimezamAtreRa.

To TWINKLE , v. n. (As the eye) nimezonmezaM kf, nimIlanonmIlanaM kf, nimIl (c. 1. -mIlati -lituM), unmIl, nimiz (c. 6. -mizati -mezituM), unmiz, locane nimIl (c. 10. -mIlayati -yituM) or unmIl. — (Sparkle tremulously) sPur (c. 6. sPurati -rituM), sPuraRaM kf.
Twirl, v. t. tvaritaM Bram c. or pari-vft c. v. i. pari-vft 1 A, Bram 1, 4 P. s. tvarita-parivftti f.
To TWIRL , v. a. tvaritaM Bram in caus. or parivft in caus.
To TWIRL , v. n. drutaM parivft or Bram or GUrRa. See To REVOLVE, v. n.
TWIRL , s. tvaritAvfttiH f., drutaparivarttanaM, drutaparivfttiH f.
Twist, v. t. pari-vyA-vft c., AkuMc c., mud-q 10. v. t. vyAvft 1 A, AkuMc pass. s. vyAvartanaM, A-, kuMcanaM, mowanaM.
TWIST: mowayati or mowwayati or moqayati (muw, muww, muq, c. 10.: Also = kill by t. ing the neck), Mr. v.
TWIST, TWISTING (subs.): mowanam, moqanam or muwwanam.
To TWIST , v. a. vyAvft (c. 10. -varttayati -yituM), Avft, samAvft, AkuYc (c. 1. -kuYcati -YcituM, c. 10. -kuYcayati -yituM).
To TWIST , v. n. vyAvft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM), Avft, AkuYc in pass.
TWIST , s. vyAvarttanaM, AvarttaH -rttakA -rttanaM, AkuYcanaM, kuYcanaM.
TWIT: upAlamate (laB, c. 1.): v. To reproach, revile.
To TWIT , v. a. ninda, upAlaB, tiraskf, parivad. See To REPROACH.
Twitch, v. t. (sahasA) Akfz 1 P, A-kzip 6 P. v. i. sPur 6 P, spaMd 1 A, pra-, kaMp 1 A. s. sahasAkarzaH-AkzepaH, sPuraRaM, spaMdanaM.
TWITCH: Akarzati (kfz, c. 1.): v. To pull.
To TWITCH , v. a. akasmAd Akfz (c. 1. -karzati -karzwuM) or Akzip.
To TWITCH , v. n. sPur (c. 6. sPurati -rituM), visPur, kamp, spand.
TWITCH , s. sPuraRaM, sPuritaM, visPuraRaM, prasPuraRaM, sPUrttiH f., spandanaM, kampanaM, AkasmikAkarzaH, AkasmikAkzepaH.
Twitter, v. i. pra-jalp 1 P, pra-lap 1 P. s. pralApaH, prajalpaH; See Chatter.
TWITTER: prajalpati (jalp, c. 1.): v. To chatter.

Two, a. dvi (dvO, dve f. n.), dvi pr.; dvayaM affixed; ‘t(wo) years’ dvivarzaM, varzadvayaM; ‘t(wo) or three’ dvitrAH; ‘t(wo)-fold’ dviguRa; ‘t(wo)-banded’ dvihasta; dvijihva &c.; ‘in t(wo) ways’ dviDA. Twice, adv. dviH, dvivAraM; ‘t(wice) married’ punarUQA, punarBUH (widow remarried); ‘20 is t(wice) 10’ dvirAvfttA daSa viMSatiH saMpadyaMte.

TWO: dvi, t. -year old: dvivarza (f. rzA): in t. ways or parts: dviDA or dveDA; of t. months: dvimAsya (f. syA); two-hundred and fifth: paYcADikadviSatatamaH (mI, maM), Mah.; t. or three days: dvitrARyahAni, R. v. 25.: v. Also both.

TWO , a. dvO m. f. du., dve n. du. (dvi), dvayaM affixed, dvi prefixed; ‘two men,’ dvO puruzO or puruzadvayaM or expressed simply by the dual, puruzO; ‘of two men,’ dvayoH puruzayoH, or simply puruzayoH; ‘two months,’ dvimAsaM, mAsadvayaM; ‘two hundred,’ dve Sate n. du., SatadvayaM, or simply Sate; ‘two thousand,’ dve sahasre, sahasradvayaM, or simply sahasre. The crude form dvi is chiefly used in Bahuvrīhi compounds; as, ‘two-armed,’ dviBujaH -jA -jaM; ‘two-footed,’ dvipAdaH -dA -daM, dvipadaH &c.; ‘two- handed,’ dvihastaH -stA -staM; ‘two-headed,’ dvimUrdDaH -rdDA -rdDaM; ‘two- [Page816-a+ 50] formed,’ dvirUpaH -pA -paM; ‘two-edged,’ dviDAraH -rA -raM, uBayata- stIkzRaH -kzRA -kzRaM; ‘consisting of two,’ dvimayaH -yI -yaM; ‘two- year-old,’ dvivArzikaH -kI -kaM; ‘in two ways,’ dviDA, dvEDaM; ‘two or three,’ dvitrAH -trAH -trARi (tra).
TWO-FOLD: (1) dviguRa (f. RA);(2) dviguRitaH (tA, taM).
TWO-FOLD , a. dviguRaH -RA -RaM, dviguRitaH -tA -taM, dviguRIkftaH &c., dvikaH -kA -kaM, dviviDaH -DA -DaM, dvEDaH -DI -DaM, dviprakAraH -rA -raM.
TYMPANITES , s. alasakaH, gulmodaraM, gulmaH. See FLATULENCE.
Tympanum, s. karRodaraM, karRaduMduBiH.

Type, s. AdarSaH; pratirUpaM; See Model. 2 cihnaM, lakzaRaM, vyaMjanaM. 3 mudrAkzaraM. 4 prakAraH, rIti f. [Typ]ical, a. Ex. by (s.) in comp.; AdarSaBUta; pratirUpaka. Typefy, v. t. AdarSIkf 8 U, pratirUpeRa dfS c. Typography, s. mudrAMkanaM.
TYPE: I Model: AdarSaH.II Mark, stamp: q. v.: cihnam.III Printing letters: mudrAkzaram. IV Kind, species: q. v.: prakAraH.

TYPE , s. (Emblem) lakzaRaM, vyaYjanaM, vyaYjakaH, cihnaM, see SYMBOL, SIGN, MARK; ‘of birth,’ utpattivyaYjakaH. — (Figure of something to come) pratirUpaM -pakaM, prativimbaM, darSakacihnaM. — (Printing letter) mudrAkzaraM. — (In medicine) BAvanA, svarUpaM.
TYPICAL , a. lAkzaRikaH -kI -kaM, udboDakaH -kA -kaM, boDakaH &c., prati- rUpakaH &c., prativimbakaH &c. See PREFIGURATIVE.
TYPIFY: AdarSayatiH v. To represent.
TYPOGRAPHER: (1) mudrayitf, (f. trI);(2) mudrANkayitf (f. trI).
TYPOGRAPHICAL , s. mudrANkanamambanDI &c., mudrAkzarasambanDI &c.
TYPOGRAPHY: (1) mudrANkanam;(2) mudrANkitam.
TYPOGRAPHY , s. mudrANkanaM, mudrAkzaraprayogaH. See PRINTING.
TYRANNIC , TYRANNICAL, a. prajApIqakaH -kA -kaM, prajopadravI -viRI &c., prajAbADakaH -kA -kaM, prajopaplavI &c. See OPPRESSIVE.
TYRANNICALLY: (1) nizWuram (= cruelly);(2) mardayat (f. ntI = crushing: q. v.).
TYRANNICALLY , adv. sanEzWuryyaM, sakrOryyaM, prajApIqakavat.
TYRANNICIDE: I The act.: prajApIqakahatyA and sim. comp. s.II The killer: prajApIqakaGAtin (f. nI) and sim. comp. s.
TYRANNICIDE , s. (The act) prajApIqakahatyA. — (The agent) prajApIqa- kahantA m. (ntf).

To TYRANNIZE , v. n. kuSAsanaM kf, anItiSAsanaM kf, asamyakSAsanaM kf, asamyakpAlanaM kf, prajApIqanaM kf, prajopadravaM kf, prajopaplavaM kf, anyAya- SAsanaM kf; ‘tyrannized over,’ upadrutaH -tA -taM.
TYRANNIZE OVER: (1) nizWuraM SAsti (SAs, c. 2. = rule rigorously);(2) pIqayati (pIq, c. 10. = oppress: q. v.).

Tyranny, s. prajApIqanaM, lokopaplavaH, janamardanaM, nizWuraSAsanaM. [Tyrann]ic, [Tyrann]ical, a. prajopaplavin, prajopadravin. [Tyrann]ize, v. t. (BfSaM) pIq 10, upa-plu 1 A, vipra-kf 8 U, upadru 1 P. Tyrant, s. prajApIqakaH, lokopaplAvakaH, upadravin m., nizWuraSAsanaH.
TYRANNY: (1) nizWuraSAsanam (= cruel govern- -ment);(2) prajApIqanam, janamardanam, lokamardanam, and sim. comp. s (= oppression of people).

TYRANNY , s. (Absolute monarchy) svatantrarAjyaM, anirbanDarAjyaM. — (Oppressive rule) kuSAsanaM, prajApIqanaM, prajopadravaH, prajopaplavaH, nizWuratA, nEzWuryyaM, pariplavaH, see OPPRESSION, To TYRANNIZE.
TYRANT: I A monarch: aDISvaraH.II Oppressor: q. v.:(1) prajApIqaka (f. qikA); (2) lokopaplAvaka (f. vikA), and sim. comp. s.
TYRANT , s. prajApIqakaH, upadravI m., nizWuraH, see OPPRESSOR.
Tyre, s. nemi f.
Tyro, s. navacCAtraH-SizyaH, anaByastaH.
TYRO , s. navaCAtraH, CAtraH, navaSizyaH, nUtanaSizyaH, nUtanAByAsI m. (n), vidyAramBakaH, kriyAkAraH, kiYcijjYaH.
